去盧恩·米德加茲要3個罐頭！
去修瓦魯茲巴魯德要6個，去阿魯納菲茲要5個。
修瓦魯茲巴魯德是禁止魔法的國家，而阿魯納菲茲似乎被詛咒了！

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Where are you going without canned food...?
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
沒帶罐頭要去哪裡啊...？

scripts.text:
[Portali]
Then to {0}~
scripts.translation:
[波塔利]
那麼，去{0}~

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Wow, this is nice weather. Do you like this kind of weather, too? But I need to do my work now.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
哇，天氣真好。你也喜歡這種天氣嗎？不過我現在得去工作了。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I would ask for your help, if you were a stronger advanturer...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
如果你是個更強的冒險家，我或許會請求你的幫助...

scripts.text: ^770099This cat is working on something, but she asks for help above level 60.^000000
scripts.translation: ^770099這隻貓正在研究一些東西，但她希望60級以上的冒險家能來幫忙。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Would you come here and open your bag for me?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
你能過來幫我把背包開啟嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There are many beautiful fish around here. So I feel my heart beating standing here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
這裡有很多漂亮的魚。站在這裡，我感到心跳加速。

scripts.text: I think my heart is beating faster...
scripts.translation: 我覺得我的心跳得更快了...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
How come you only know about eating! My heart doesn't only beat for food.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
你怎麼只知道吃！我的心跳不僅僅是為了食物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I've studied at a human university before and I learned to speak there so don't treat me like some animal.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我以前在人類大學學習過，在那裡學會了說話，所以別把我當成普通的動物。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I am a scholar of fish research.
It's important for cats to research fish.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我是魚類研究的學者。
對貓來說，研究魚是很重要的。

scripts.text: How's your research going?
scripts.translation: 你的研究進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I was a good friend of admiral Thomas but our ship hasn't gone back to sea since we arrived here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我是托馬斯提督的好朋友，但自從我們到達這裡，船就沒有再出海了。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
The shipmates seem to be pretty lonely.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
船員們似乎很寂寞。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
A scholar from the university came here to research us and thought it was amazing to find a cat that speaks his language already.
So he's been helping me teach the others.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
一位來自大學的學者來這裡研究我們，他驚訝地發現竟然有一隻貓已經會說人類的語言。
所以他一直在幫我教其他貓。

scripts.text: Is that why I understand all the cats?
scripts.translation: 這就是為什麼我能聽懂所有貓的話嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Yes, exactly!
I was one of the few cats who could talk to humans before that scholar arrived.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
是的，沒錯！
在那位學者到來之前，我是少數能與人類對話的貓之一。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Anyways, now I'm collecting specimens to study the monsters here. I hope you can help me.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
總之，我現在正在收集標本，研究這裡的魔物。希望你能幫幫我。

scripts.text: How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text: I have to decline.
scripts.translation: 我不得不拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, okay. If you change your mind, please come again.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
哦，好的。如果你改變主意，請再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
There is a monster called a Pouring who's eating all fish in the Octopus and Culvert dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
有一種叫水滴波利的魔物，正在小章魚和下水道迷宮裡吃掉所有的魚。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
It suddenly appeared during the winter, so could you collect the specimens of Unidentified Fish after getting rid of it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
它是在冬天突然出現的，所以你能在消滅它之後，收集一些未識別的魚的標本嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
You can get Unidentified Fish from the Pouring monsters, so please collect 30 of them.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
你可以從水滴波利身上獲得未識別的魚，請收集30個。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, thank you! I will take these specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
哦，謝謝你！我會收下這些標本的。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I want to give you something, but the last one is out of stock now so I will just write your name here.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
我想送你點東西，但最後一件已經賣完了，所以我就把你的名字寫在這裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I can give you good news even from a distance, but it's only possible if I am really lucky...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
即使隔著這麼遠，我也能給你帶好訊息，不過那得看我運氣夠不夠好...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
I'm sorry, but please collect 30 Unidentified Fish specimens.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
很抱歉，請收集30個未識別的魚標本。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Oh, you met admiral Tomas... how was it?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
哦，你見到托馬海軍上將了...感覺怎麼樣？

scripts.text: He looks gentle
scripts.translation: 他看起來很溫柔

scripts.text: He looks terrible
scripts.translation: 他看起來很糟糕

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Hmm...
Frankly speaking, I was a real fan of Admiral Tomas. Can you take responsibility for your word?
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
嗯...
說實話，我是托馬海軍上將的忠實粉絲。你能對自己的話負責嗎？

scripts.text: Just kidding!
scripts.translation: 開玩笑的！

scripts.text: Oh yes, he was really terrible!
scripts.translation: 是的，他真的很糟糕！

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?
Okay, it really depends on personal taste...
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
是嗎？
好吧，這確實很看個人口味...

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Is he?
I knew you would say so.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
是嗎？
我就知道你會這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Admiral Tomas is a legendary figure who has led all of us in voyaging to this island. I think it was the happiest moment in my life.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
托馬海軍上將是一位傳奇人物，他帶領我們航行到了這座島嶼。我想那是我生命中最幸福的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
Please help him a lot. There are not many people to trust. This is my personal request.
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
請多幫助他。可以信任的人並不多。這是我個人的請求。

scripts.text:
[Pipielle]
And this is a small gift for looking after admiral Tomas.
^0000ffReceived 200 E Class Coins.^000000
scripts.translation:
[皮皮埃爾]
這是照顧托馬海軍上將的一點小禮物。
^0000ff獲得了200個E級代幣。^000000

scripts.text: - Can't go next step due to having too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 物品欄已滿，無法進行下一步。-

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Hmm, investigation is not enough.
We need go back to basic point.
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
嗯，調查還不夠。
我們需要回到最基本的地方。
明天再來吧。
我可能又會像往常一樣肚子疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Are you here to help
or to get help?
You look so weak, haha...
Go and hunt more Porings!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你是來幫忙的，還是來求幫助的？
你看起來好弱啊，哈哈...
去多打點波利吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Will you listen my sorrow?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你願意聽我傾訴一下嗎？

scripts.text: Sure I will.
scripts.translation: 當然願意。

scripts.text: No, I won't.
scripts.translation: 不，我不會。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
This is a sad story.
As usual, I unpacked the bag
to see strange cats
to show them.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
這是個悲傷的故事。
像往常一樣，我開啟袋子，
想給奇怪的貓們看看。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
There were lots of cans.
I thougt it was new due to different shape
but it was bad cans!
I ate too much and
got in bed right away
so I can't do anything...
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
那裡有很多罐頭。
因為形狀不同，我以為是新貨，
結果卻是劣質罐頭！
我吃得太多了，
直接躺到床上去了，
現在什麼都做不了...

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
And by the way, you have...
nice colthes.
I can't let you go,
that hurts me so badly!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
順便說一句，你的
衣服很漂亮。
我不能讓你走，
那樣我會很痛苦的！

scripts.text: You deserve the pain!
scripts.translation: 你活該痛苦！

scripts.text: Need help?
scripts.translation: 需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Yes you are!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
You know what care is.
Please find the bad provider
and revenge our enemy!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你知道什麼是關懷。
請找到那個不良供應商，
為我們的敵人復仇！

scripts.text: No, I don't want to!
scripts.translation: 不，我不想！

scripts.text: Yes, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 是的，我答應！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
For the peace in Malangdo,
just lay in bed forever.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為了馬拉多的和平，
就永遠躺在床上吧。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I will!
I will have your peace first once I get well!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我會的！
等我好了，我會先享受你的和平！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Okay, you can do it?
The enemy must be near the dock
where we got the bundle.
We should get them to help
our cats' well-being!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
好的，你能做到嗎？
敵人應該就在我們拿到包裹的碼頭附近。
我們應該讓他們
幫助我們的貓健康！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Why are you here!
If I am usual, I will engrave something
with your tear...
Let your bag be here instead!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你為什麼在這裡！
如果我正常的話，我會用你的眼淚
刻點什麼...
讓你的包留在這裡代替吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
The enemy must be near the dock
where we got the bundle.
We should get them to help
our cats' well-being!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
敵人應該就在我們拿到包裹的碼頭附近。
我們應該讓他們
幫助我們的貓健康！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I am so tired due to
lack of forbidden bad activity.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
因為缺乏禁止的壞活動，
我累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Was it from raccoon that made us pain in stomach?
Oh bad raccoon!
I feel stomachache again from this anger!
All right, I will show my power once
I can get out of bed.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
是浣熊讓我們肚子疼的嗎？
哦，壞浣熊！
這憤怒讓我又胃疼了！
好吧，等我下床後，
我會展示我的力量。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
I need time to concentrate on my stomachache.
You can go now!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
我需要時間集中注意力在胃疼上。
你現在可以走了！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
How do you know the source of bad can?
Do you have time to do slow at the moment?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你怎麼知道劣質罐頭的來源？
你現在有時間慢慢做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
The Patrol Leader wants to go back to
bad world as soon as possible.
I want you to go first to soothe him instead.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
巡邏隊長想盡快回到
那個糟糕的世界。
我想讓你先去安撫他。
怎麼樣？

scripts.text: It's troublsome, I quit.
scripts.translation: 太麻煩了，我退出。

scripts.text: Sure I will!
scripts.translation: 當然我會！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Haha, you think it is a bad word.
I want you to be one of our staffs.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
哈哈，你覺得這是個壞詞。
我想讓你成為我們的職員之一。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Sorry, but you should go now
so that I can concentrate on my stomachache.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
抱歉，你現在該走了，
這樣我才能專心治我的胃痛。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
All right, then I will have time
to concentrate on my stomachache.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
好吧，這樣我就有時間
專心治我的胃痛了。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Hmm, investigation is not enough.
We need go back to basic point.
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
嗯，調查還不夠。
我們需要回到最基本的地方。
明天再來吧。
我可能又會像往常一樣肚子疼。

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Go and have fun with the Patrol Leader!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
去和巡邏隊長好好玩吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Instead of us, you did bad behavior.
Good to hear that?
This is what teacher see best pupil?
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
明明是我們，你卻做了壞事。
聽到這個你很高興嗎？
這就是老師眼中最好的學生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
You deserve a reward!
I need to get some more rest,
so let's investigate tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
你值得獲得獎勵！
我需要多休息一會兒，
所以明天再調查吧！

scripts.text:
[Gobonge]
Come again tomorrow.
I might be in pain of stomach
like usual.
scripts.translation:
[戈邦格]
明天再來吧。
我可能又會像往常一樣胃痛。

scripts.text:
[Gobulee]
What a time to show up!
You should come around when we're healthy.
scripts.translation:
[戈布利]
真是時候不湊巧啊！
你應該在我們健康的時候再來。

scripts.text:
[Gobyungee]
I can't even look another cat in the eye since I'm too sick to be doin' crimes properly.
scripts.translation:
[戈比昂吉]
我病得太重，連犯罪都做得不好，
甚至不敢直視其他貓的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Gosigee]
I wish I had some peppy bistmuth pills...
Meanwhile the Captain only thinks about catching the bad guys and getting revenge!
...
scripts.translation:
[戈西吉]
真希望我有幾顆讓人精神振奮的鉍片...
與此同時，船長只想著抓住壞人並復仇！
...

scripts.text:
[Gosigee]
How can we follow someone so single-minded!
scripts.translation:
[戈西吉]
我們怎麼跟得上這麼一心一意的人呢！

scripts.text:
[Gonanee]
We are the only violent gang in Malangdo and we are very proud.
I don't feel right just lying in bed.
scripts.translation:
[戈納尼]
我們是馬拉格多唯一的暴力幫派，我們非常自豪。
只是躺在床上讓我感覺不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Godoree]
I saw unfamiliar cats around
the dock recently.
Are they tourists?
I should -inspect- their pockets
once I'm better...
scripts.translation:
[戈多里]
最近我在碼頭附近看到了陌生的貓。
它們是遊客嗎？
等我好了之後，我要-檢查-一下它們的口袋...

scripts.text:
He appears to be listening intently.
Upon hearing you approach, he pretends to be completely oblivious.
scripts.translation:
他似乎正在專心傾聽。
聽到你走近，他假裝完全沒注意到。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Oh the pain, oh the pain of it all...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
哦，好痛，這一切都好痛...

scripts.text:
On listening to the story for
a while, he pretends to be indifferent once hearing someone's noise.
scripts.translation: 聽了故事一會兒，聽到有人靠近的聲音，他假裝毫不在意。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Could it BE any smoggier today?
scripts.translation:
[極其可疑的商人]
今天的霧能再大一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[A Foolish Cat]
If you stay here, you
can hear all they're saying.
Don't know exactly what, but
you do hear everything.
Hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[一隻笨貓]
如果你留在這裡，
就能聽到他們說的所有話。
雖然不知道具體是什麼，
但你確實能聽到一切。
嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text: You hear a conversation between the Suspious Dealers.
scripts.translation: 你聽到了可疑商人之間的對話。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Because unexpected robbery at that moment...
our great work has delayed.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
因為當時發生了意外的搶劫...
我們偉大的工作被延誤了。

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
Do not worry about the thing, I placed it near balloon bag where
Ship Navi is in the north, and I hid it perfectly.
scripts.translation:
[極其可疑的商人]
別擔心那件事，我把它放在了北方船導航員附近的袋子旁邊，
我藏得很完美。

scripts.text: You need to check a place near north of balloon bag in ship Navi.
scripts.translation: 你需要去檢查位於北方氣球袋附近的船導航員。

scripts.text: You still hear a suspicious conversation.
scripts.translation: 你依然能聽到可疑的對話。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
But near the balloon bag is still
worrying so much!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
但是氣球袋附近的情況
還是很讓人擔心！

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
Oh how cowardly you are!
I hid it in ship Navi perfectly.
Relax!
scripts.translation:
[極其可疑的商人]
你真是膽小如鼠！
我把它完美地藏在船導航員那裡了。
放心吧！

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
The rest of part is in staffs.
We should believe.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
剩下的部分在職員那裡。
我們應該相信他們。

scripts.text:
We need to investigate Navi first.
Let's see other guys in ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
我們需要先調查導航員。
讓我們看看船導航員那裡的其他人。

scripts.text: You still hear a suspicious conversation.
scripts.translation: 你依然能聽到可疑的對話。

scripts.text:
[Suspious Dealer]
Star candy is still healthy,
what happens?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的商人]
星星糖還安然無恙，
發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Very Suspious Dealer]
No way...
We should get more bad cans.
scripts.translation:
[極其可疑的商人]
不可能...
我們得弄更多壞罐頭。

scripts.text: There's a memo.
scripts.translation: 有一張備忘。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Here is not what we wanted, huh!
scripts.translation:
[備忘]

My curious food is...
^4d4dff {0} ^000000 .
Just one dish is enough, so please do it together.
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
我好奇的料理是...
^4d4dff {0} ^000000。
只要一道菜就夠了，請一起帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
You have to bring the dish that made from fresh ingredients.
^ff0000I will refuse the instant food.^000000
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
你必須用新鮮食材製作的料理帶過來。
^ff0000我會拒絕即食食品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Hey my friend, you have a bad memory.
Did you already take my order list?
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
嘿，我的朋友，你的記性真差。
你已經接過我的訂單清單了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Do you remember what I ask to bring?
I have no idea.
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
你記得我讓你帶什麼嗎？
我完全沒印象。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
What did I say to bring?
I don't remember?
Did you get something wrong to come here?
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
我讓你帶什麼來著？
我不記得了？
你是不是搞錯了才來這裡的？

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Is that ingredients of cat's ship biscuit and the food of human?
Let me check what you brought...
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
那是貓餅乾的食材，還有人類的料理嗎？
讓我看看你帶了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Great.
This is that food!
It will be good reference. Well done.
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
很好。
這就是那種料理！
這會是不錯的參考。幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Alright, could you come tomorrow?
When the time to you coming, I'm very excited.
Nyahuh Nyahuh
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
好的，明天能來嗎？
當你來的時候，我非常期待。
喵嗚 喵嗚

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
Yummm...
Did I overestimate your ability?
Double check what is short and bring them properly.
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
美味...
我是不是高估你的能力了？
仔細檢查還缺什麼，並正確地帶來。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
There is not different from undiscerning young cat.
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
這和沒見識的小貓沒什麼兩樣。

scripts.text:
[Chef Nyas]
You are quite bold like a killer whale.
If you don't have any business, don't touch vegetable and go away.
scripts.translation:
[廚師 尼亞斯]
你像虎鯨一樣大膽。
如果沒有事，別碰蔬菜，快離開。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄太滿了，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Seems like a visitor.
How does this island look?
It is hard to believe, but this ground is very soft, so we named this island Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
看起來像是訪客。
這座島看起來怎麼樣？
雖然難以置信，但這地面非常柔軟，所以我們把這座島命名為馬拉貢多。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
If you were a more professional adventurer, I'd ask you one thing...
Well, I won't do it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
如果你是個更專業的冒險者，我會問你一件事...
算了，我不問了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey there.
I am Rato, do you have a moment?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嘿，你好。
我是拉托，你有空嗎？

scripts.text: Yeah, sure I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有空。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Well, nothing special, but could you do me a favor?
Did you see the kids gathered on your way here?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嗯，沒什麼特別的事，但你能幫我個忙嗎？
你在來的路上看到聚集的小孩們了嗎？

scripts.text: Kids?
scripts.translation: 小孩？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes yes, baby kids.
They are the youngest kids among the merchants and crews.
They feel anxious that they might not be able to go back home.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
是的，是的，小寶寶們。
他們是商人和船員中最年幼的孩子。
他們擔心自己可能無法回家，感到很焦慮。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
And they are getting bored of living on this small island.
They already tasted sea and adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
而且他們厭倦了在這座小島上生活。
他們已經嘗過了大海和冒險的滋味...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They used to play with making things, but seem tired of that also...
If it's okay, would you play with them for a while?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們以前喜歡玩製作東西的遊戲，但似乎也玩膩了...
如果不介意的話，你能陪他們玩一會兒嗎？

scripts.text: Uh, sure...
scripts.translation: 嗯，好吧...

scripts.text: I don't have enough time for that.
scripts.translation: 我沒有足夠的時間做那件事。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, thank you!
Then, where are they?
Maybe near Beginning Compass...?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，謝謝你！
那麼，他們在哪裡？
也許在起始羅盤附近...？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They are so active that I am not sure where they are now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們太活潑了，我不確定他們現在在哪裡。
如果你遇到他們，請陪他們玩一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
It's okay even though you cannot do this right now.
If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是嗎？
雖然你現在沒空也沒關係。
如果你遇到他們，請陪他們玩一會兒。

scripts.text: If you meet them, please spend time with them.
scripts.translation: 如果你遇到他們，請陪他們玩一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
Please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的是查羅，有著金色的毛髮。
羅庫是黑色的毛髮，羅西是白色的毛髮。
請照顧好他們。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, really?
I am sorry for disturbing you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，是嗎？
抱歉打擾你了。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
The youngest one is Charo, with gold fur.
Roku has black fur, and Rosy has white fur.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
最小的是查羅，有著金色的毛髮。
羅庫是黑色的毛髮，羅西是白色的毛髮。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
We can look forward to the moment we can go back home if these children grow up nicely.
For that reason, please take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
如果這些孩子能好好長大，我們就能期待回到家的日子了。
所以，請照顧好他們。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Do kids disturb you too much?
What... adventurer group? Did you play with toys from the adventurer group?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
孩子們太吵了嗎？
什麼...冒險者團體？你是用冒險者團體的玩具玩的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I really worried about them the first time we were shipwrecked to this island...
They thought the first voyage was huge adventure...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
第一次被衝到這個島上時，我真的很擔心他們...
他們覺得第一次航行就是一場巨大的冒險...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
They look excited, like they got a fever.
It seems like yesterday that I made toys for them and soothed them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們看起來興奮得像是發燒了一樣。
感覺就像昨天我才給他們做玩具安撫他們...

scripts.text: Rato seems to be in brown study.
scripts.translation: 拉托似乎在沉思。

scripts.text:
You didn't bring the pieces of the painting.
Please take it with you.
scripts.translation:
你沒有帶來畫作的碎片。
請把它帶走。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
What's going on?
It should be very hard to take care of the kids even though I asked you, isn't it?
I am sorry, I should take care of them...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
怎麼了？
雖然是我拜託你的，但照顧孩子一定很困難吧？
對不起，我應該自己照顧他們的...

scripts.text: You hand Rato a piece of painting.
scripts.translation: 你把畫作的碎片遞給拉托。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Oh, this is a piece of painting?
Ah!!!
Has this painting been torn up already?
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
哦，這是畫作的碎片？
啊！！！
這幅畫已經被撕碎了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Did they say this is a gift for me?
Huhhuh, a piece of painting?
HAHAHAHAHA!
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
他們說這是送給我的禮物？
呼呼呼，畫作的碎片？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Okay, I will patch up this painting by myself.
They are still the same.
I think I should worry about myself first...
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
好吧，我會自己修補這幅畫的。
他們還是老樣子。
我覺得我應該先擔心一下自己...

scripts.text:
[Rato]
It's very kind of you to play with the kids.
This is for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
謝謝你陪孩子們玩。
這是給你的。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
I owe you a big favor!
Let's drink today!
Miaow~
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
我欠你一個大人情！
今天一起喝酒吧！
喵嗚~

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Hey, how's it going? If you have time please look at it.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
嘿，最近怎麼樣？如果有時間的話請看一下這個。

scripts.text: Look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 看看畫

scripts.text: Don't look at a picture.
scripts.translation: 不看畫

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Yes, they drew this picture full of happiness.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
是的，他們畫了這幅充滿幸福的畫。

scripts.text: Appreciate the picture in the frame.
scripts.translation: 欣賞相框裡的畫。

scripts.text:
[Rato]
Why don't you look at such a nice picture?
I'm disapointed.
scripts.translation:
[拉托]
這麼好看的畫你都不看嗎？
真讓人失望。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄太滿了，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
scripts.translation:
有幾隻貓看起來比其他隊員年紀小。
他們正在嚴肅地討論面前那臺奇怪的機器。

scripts.text:
There are cats who seem younger than the other crew.
They are having a serious conversation about the weird machine in front of them.
They look like the kids that Rato told me about.
scripts.translation:
有幾隻貓看起來比其他隊員年紀小。
他們正在嚴肅地討論面前那臺奇怪的機器。
他們看起來就像拉托跟我說的那些小孩。

scripts.text: Just watch them without a word.
scripts.translation: 默默地看著他們

scripts.text: Busy right now.
scripts.translation: 現在很忙

scripts.text: You try to listen to the conversation without disturbing them.
scripts.translation: 你試圖在不打擾他們的情況下偷聽他們的談話。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
When will it be fixed? When it will be done?
Isn't this the last one?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
什麼時候能修好？什麼時候能完工？
這不是最後一個嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um... you don't even get tried of it?
Anyway, we are in trouble.
The glass bead is broken.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
嗯...你們難道不覺得煩嗎？
總之，我們遇到麻煩了。
玻璃珠碎了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Don't we have an extra glass bead?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
我們有沒有備用的玻璃珠？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
No, we don't have any.
We can't fix this without it, right?
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
沒有，我們一個都沒有。
沒有它，我們修不了這個，對吧？

scripts.text: The cats look your way at the same time.
scripts.translation: 那些貓同時看向了你。

scripts.text: I have a spare Glass Bead!
scripts.translation: 我有備用的玻璃珠！

scripts.text: Why are you guys staring at me?
scripts.translation: 你們為什麼盯著我看？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is no glass bead.
Don't lie to us.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
沒有玻璃珠。
別騙我們。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really? Oh, really?
It's a bead! And a shining glass bead as well!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
真的嗎？哦，真的嗎？
是珠子！而且是一顆閃閃發光的玻璃珠！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hmm. This is enough to replace it.
Like this...
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
嗯。這個足夠用來替換了。
就這樣...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
And then here, this?
Done.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
然後，這裡呢？
完成了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Exciting!!!
Okay, adventurer! We'll give you the right to use this machine!
Try this whenever you want to!!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
太棒了！！！
好了，冒險者！我們授予你使用這臺機器的權利！
隨時都可以來試試哦！！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Advanturer! This is a delicious can.
You can get whatever you want with cans in this island. It is tradable.
Rosy, Roku and I collected them.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
冒險者！這是一罐美味的罐頭。
在這個島上，罐頭可以買到你想要的任何東西。它是可以交易的。
羅西、羅庫和我收集了它們。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
And adventurer!
If you were a real adventurer,
you would clear all Nyadventures
made by the Meow Bravery Team!
Challenge it whenever you want to!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
還有，冒險者！
如果你是一個真正的冒險者，
你一定會完成由喵勇隊製作的所有喵冒險！
隨時都可以來挑戰哦！

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We are just looking at you as you stand there.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
我們就只是看著你站在那裡。

scripts.text: I'll come again later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We fixed the Duruduru compass, we only need a visitor now...
Hey, do you want to be a visitor?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我們修好了嘟嘟羅盤，現在只需要一位訪客了...
嘿，你想當訪客嗎？

scripts.text: A visitor?
scripts.translation: 訪客？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is an adventure course made by the Meow adventure team.
Especially we have added studying course this time.
It's simple to solve, you only need to find compass in this island according to order.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這是由喵冒險隊製作的冒險課程。
這次我們特別加入了學習課程。
解題很簡單，你只需要按照順序在這個島上找到羅盤即可。

scripts.text: I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation: 我試試看。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here is your Adventure Card.
This is the Duruduru Compass which we fixed with the glass bead you gave us.
And this is the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這是你的冒險卡。
這是我們用你給我們的玻璃珠修好的嘟嘟羅盤。
還有這個，是起始羅盤。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you put the Adventure Card in here!
This machine is for testing essential ingredients of adventure.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
把冒險卡插在這裡，遊戲就會開始！
這臺機器是用來測試冒險必備要素的。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't forget the destination for successful adventure.
And you should find a way to get to your destination as fast as possible.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
別忘了成功冒險的目的地。
而且你應該儘快找到到達目的地的方法。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You will be good, as you are a good person for giving us the glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你會做得很好的，畢竟你是個好人，還給了我們玻璃珠。

scripts.text:
Got Adventure Card from the yellow cat Charo.
It seems to work if I put this card in the slot in the Beginning Compass.
scripts.translation:
從黃貓查羅那裡拿到了冒險卡。
看起來把這張卡插進起始羅盤的插槽裡就能用了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
把冒險卡在起始羅盤上刮一下，遊戲就會開始！
起始羅盤會告訴你該去哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
^4d4dff如果你通過了所有的羅盤，最後你會看到來自“納維”號船的喵鈴！
敲響新鈴鐺！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Ah... you are not going to do it...
Um...
Sob~
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
啊...你不打算做嗎...
嗯...
嗚~
喵~

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Hey, adventurer. Don't make kids cry!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
嘿，冒險者。別讓孩子哭！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh? Isn't this failed stamp from Bubi?
I'm really disappointed.
Try again~ you can make it!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
哦？這不是布比失敗的印章嗎？
我真的很失望。
再試一次~ 你能做到的！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The game will start if you scratch Adventure Card to the Beginning Compass!
The Beginning Compass will let you know where you should go.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
把冒險卡在起始羅盤上刮一下，遊戲就會開始！
起始羅盤會告訴你該去哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
^4d4dffIf you go through all the compasses, you will see Meowbell from the ship Navi at last!
Ring the New bell!^000000
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
^4d4dff如果你通過了所有的羅盤，最後你會看到來自“納維”號船的喵鈴！
敲響新鈴鐺！^000000

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Where is your Adventure Card?
You should bring it with you.
You can't be serious that you threw it away with your other trash!!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你的冒險卡在哪裡？
你應該隨身帶著它。
你不會真的把它和你的其他垃圾一起扔了吧！！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I heard it!
I heard sound of Meowbell!
You are great!
The next will be a big case!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我聽到了！
我聽到了喵鈴的聲音！
你太棒了！
接下來將是一樁大案子！

scripts.text: The next?
scripts.translation: 接下來？

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are member of the Meow Bravery Team while you have the card with you.
We need an adventurer like you anyways, since this is a big case.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
只要帶著這張卡，你就是喵勇者小隊的成員。
反正我們需要像你這樣的冒險者，畢竟這是一樁大案子。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
It's for the cuff.
It seems a bomb is planted in this island.
The detective has went for this case already.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這是為了手銬。
似乎這座島上被安置了炸彈。
偵探已經去處理這個案子了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You should go there too!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你也應該去那裡！

scripts.text: Why do I have to go there?
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要去那裡？

scripts.text: What an adventure! I'll take it!
scripts.translation: 多麼刺激的冒險！我接了！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
This is a big case!
And this island could explode!
Oh, you might shut your eyes to the fact.
Give the Adventure Card back!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
這是一樁大案子！
而且這座島可能會爆炸！
哦，你竟然想視而不見。
把冒險卡還給我！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你作為冒險者的能力非常出色！
請幫助陷入困境的偵探和他的朋友，同時也拯救這座島！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
但請務必秘密行動！
因此你需要領取這個證件。
不能讓偵探誤會你是敵人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 將冒險卡A 變更為冒險卡B。-

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
偉大的偵探和他的朋友會在“納維”號船附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you feel a disposition to help the detective and his friend?
Don't you?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你有想要幫助偵探和他朋友的意願嗎？
難道沒有嗎？

scripts.text: Yes I do.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有。

scripts.text: No I don't.
scripts.translation: 不，我沒有。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You have great capabilities as an adventurer!
Please help detective and his friend who got in trouble and also save this island!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你作為冒險者的能力非常出色！
請幫助陷入困境的偵探和他的朋友，同時也拯救這座島！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
But be sure this should be done undercover!
Therefore you need to take this certification.
It shouldn't happen that the detective misunderstands you as an enemy!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
但請務必秘密行動！
因此你需要領取這個證件。
不能讓偵探誤會你是敵人！

scripts.text: - Changed Adventure Card A into Adventure Card B. -
scripts.translation: - 將冒險卡A 變更為冒險卡B。-

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be acound ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
偉大的偵探和他的朋友會在“納維”號船附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh my god, the great detective and the ship Navi...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
天哪，偉大的偵探和“納維”號船...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
The great detective and his friend will be around the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
偉大的偵探和他的朋友會在“納維”號船附近。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I have been waiting for you...~
Oh, I am short of breath from coming here in a hurry.
Hmph... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我一直在等你...~
哦，我急匆匆趕過來，有點喘不過氣了。
哼...喵...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Don't you have anything to show me?
Let me see it quickly!
Take it out!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你沒有什麼東西要給我看嗎？
快點讓我看看！
拿出來！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
What? You don't have it?
It can't be true.
Surely you took this with you...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
什麼？你沒有帶？
這不可能。
你肯定把它帶在身邊了...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
How come it happened?
This painting is very important for us.
Please give it back to us.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
怎麼會發生這種事？
這幅畫對我們來說非常重要。
請把它還給我們。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Yes, this is it!
This is our...
But, how do we put the broken pieces together?
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
沒錯，就是這個！
這是我們的...
但是，該怎麼把碎片拼回去呢？

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
We need a board and glue as well to put it together.
That's too troublesome to just give it away!
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
我們需要一塊板和膠水才能把它拼好。
光是這樣送出去太麻煩了吧！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Rato, looks like he is happy.
He will understand.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
拉托，看起來他很高興。
他會明白的。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Really...?
There is no Meow team and us without Rato.
I feel a little bad to give only pieces of painting but...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
真的嗎...？
沒有拉托，就沒有喵隊和我們。
只送畫片過去，我覺得有點過意不去...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We have no other way!
Rato treated this by himself!
No, it's better to ask Rato to put this back together.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我們別無他法！
拉托自己會處理好的！
不，還是讓拉托自己把它拼回去比較好。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Good idea.
That's really a good idea.
I was getting tired of it.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
好主意。
真是個好主意。
我都快被它煩死了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You are a member of the Meow Bravery Team.
Please give these pieces of painting to Rato.
And tell him to treat it preciously as our treasure...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你是喵勇隊的成員。
請把這些畫片交給拉托。
並告訴他，請像對待我們的寶物一樣珍視它...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
We couldn't make the Bravery Team without Rato.
Please.
Tell him we didn't forget our home island.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
沒有拉托，我們就組不成勇隊。
拜託了。
告訴他，我們沒有忘記我們的家鄉島嶼。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Please give this pating to Rato.
We drawed this painting to show Rato.
Please.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
請把這幅畫交給拉托。
我們畫這幅畫是為了給拉托看的。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Here you are! Our emeritus member of the new Bravery Team!
Where did you go for adventure today?
Are these adventure stories?!
If not, then...
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
給你！新勇隊的榮譽成員！
你今天去哪裡冒險了？
這些是冒險故事嗎？！
如果不是，那麼...

scripts.text:
[Charo]
You might have come here for the compass race like huge tuna from our Meow Bravery Team!!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你可能是像我們喵勇隊的大金槍魚一樣，來參加指南針比賽的吧！！
喵！

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Well, Homnya and Nyangson are too difficult for me.
...?
I meant the book is difficult for me.
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
嗯，霍姆尼亞和喵森對我來說太難了。
...？
我是說這本書對我來說太難了。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Do you know how much Rato loves the painting which you have found?
He put framed the painting on the wall!
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
你知道拉托有多喜歡你找到的那幅畫嗎？
他把畫框起來掛在牆上了！
喵~

scripts.text:
[Charo]
I miss my hometown.
But Malangdo is also my hometown as well.
I am okay with us all together in here~
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
我想念我的家鄉。
但馬拉格多也是我的家鄉。
我們大家在一起在這裡，我就很好~

scripts.text:
A young cat with white fur tries so hard with the weird machine.
The machine might be broken.
scripts.translation:
一隻白毛小貓正努力擺弄著那個奇怪的機器。
機器可能壞了。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Um? The adventurer who brought us the glass bead?
I really thank you for that.
We could fix the compass with that glass bead.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
嗯？是給我們帶來玻璃珠的冒險者嗎？
真的非常感謝你。
我們靠那顆玻璃珠修好了指南針。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Adventure Card? Will you do the Duruduru race?
It's hard to say it's fun even though we made it.
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
冒險卡片？你要參加嘟嘟魯比賽嗎？
雖然是我們做的，但很難說它有趣。

scripts.text:
[Charo]
Oh, it's fun! Perfectly fun!
I have remodeled it this time!!
It will be really fun!!
scripts.translation:
[查羅]
哦，很有趣！非常有趣！
這次我重新改裝了它！！
一定會很好玩的！！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Yes. It's fun, as Charo said.
Maybe.
...
It is.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
是的。就像查羅說的那樣，很有趣。
也許吧。
...
確實如此。

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Meow...
I feel sleepy today.
I've had sore throat these day because I talked too much...
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
喵...
我今天好睏。
這幾天話太多，嗓子都疼了...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Don't you agree with me, friend?
...?
Oh, I didn't even realize...
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
朋友，你同意我的說法嗎？
...？
哎呀，我都沒注意到...

scripts.text:
[Rosy]
Forget about it!
Doesn't this machine ever break?
scripts.translation:
[羅西]
算了！
這臺機器怎麼老是壞？

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄太滿了，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
A young black cat helps the busy white cat.
Maybe the machine is broken.
scripts.translation:
一隻小黑貓正在幫忙碌的白貓。
也許機器真的壞了。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Oh? You are the one who gave us the glass bead.
Thanks a lot.
I am happy, too, because Charo looks happy.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
哦？是給我們玻璃珠的那位。
非常感謝。
我也很高興，因為查羅看起來很開心。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes it.
It will be fun.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
查羅很喜歡它。
一定很好玩。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo has been waiting for so long.
To Charo...
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
查羅已經等了很久了。
給查羅...

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Do you have something to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你有什麼要告訴我的嗎？

scripts.text: Report results of the race.
scripts.translation: 彙報比賽結果

scripts.text: Challenge the race.
scripts.translation: 挑戰比賽

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Bubi, no confirmation stamps and card.
You will be in trouble if you are like this.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
布比，沒有確認印章和卡片。
你這樣會惹麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Good job.
You are very smart.
This is a gift for you.
Please come tomorrow again.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
做得好。
你很聰明。
這是給你的禮物。
請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Charo likes you so much.
He will be happy if you come.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
查羅很喜歡你。
如果你來，他會很高興。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Failed...
...is it too difficult for you?
But the race is available only once a day.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
失敗了...
...這對你來說太難了嗎？
但比賽每天只能參加一次。

scripts.text: Give me one more chance!
scripts.translation: 再給我一次機會！

scripts.text: Okay.I will try tomorrow.
scripts.translation: 好的。我明天再試。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Um... Um... Well...
If you bring a Malangdo Can,
I will give you one more chance.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
嗯...嗯...好吧...
如果你帶來一罐Malangdo Can，
我會再給你一次機會。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay. Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好的。你想用1罐Malangdo Can兌換一張冒險卡嗎？

scripts.text: Exchange for Adventure Card A.
scripts.translation: 兌換冒險卡A

scripts.text: Stop it.
scripts.translation: 停下

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你已經有了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
這是你的冒險卡。
起始羅盤，出發！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好的，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay, come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好的，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have reported the result for today already.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你今天已經報告過結果了，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are too hasty.
You didn't even finish the race.
It's still going.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你太心急了。
你甚至還沒跑完比賽。
比賽還在進行中。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
The result is little weird, but...
This is neither a complete race nor incomplete race.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
結果有點奇怪，但是...
這既不是完整的比賽，也不是不完整的比賽。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Is this because of the machine?
Let's make void for this race.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
這是因為機器的問題嗎？
讓我們把這次比賽作廢吧。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have failed?
Do you want to try again?
I will delete the report of the failed result.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你失敗了？
你想再試一次嗎？
我會刪除失敗的結果報告。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
No, not yet.
Duruduru race is only once for a day.
If we do it more often, the machine will break.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
不，現在還不行。
嘟嘟羅盤比賽一天只有一次。
如果太頻繁，機器會壞掉的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
I know that you will try the Duruduru race.
I deleted your last report.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
我知道你會嘗試嘟嘟羅盤比賽。
我已經刪除了你上次的報告。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You need a Adventure Card to challenge again.
Do you want to exchange 1 Malangdo Can for a Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你需要一張冒險卡才能再次挑戰。
你想用1罐Malangdo Can兌換一張冒險卡嗎？

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card.
scripts.translation: 購買冒險卡

scripts.text: Just stop it.
scripts.translation: 停下

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You have it already?
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你已經有了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Roku]
There is nothing for free.
You need a Malangdo Can.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
沒有免費的東西。
你需要一罐Malangdo Can。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Here is your Adventure Card.
Beginning Compass, start!
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
這是你的冒險卡。
起始羅盤，出發！

scripts.text:
[Roku]
Okay.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
好的。

scripts.text:
[Roku]
You are the weird one.
scripts.translation:
[羅庫]
你才是那個奇怪的人。

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
The kids said this was the ride called Duruduru compass of the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
孩子們說這是喵之勇氣隊的嘟嘟羅盤。

scripts.text:
An iron pot contains a map of Malangdo with a card inserter.
After inserting your card, a red button and the map inside the pot light up.
It seems to start after pressing the button.
scripts.translation:
一個鐵鍋裡裝著Malangdo的地圖和卡片插槽。
插入卡片後，紅色按鈕和鍋內的地圖會亮起。
似乎按下按鈕後就會開始。

scripts.text: Start it right now.
scripts.translation: 現在就啟動

scripts.text: Start it later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再啟動

scripts.text: The card has come out with lights on the map after pressing the button.
scripts.translation: 按下按鈕後，卡片隨著地圖上的燈光亮了起來。

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 遊戲已經開始了！

scripts.text: The game has started already!
scripts.translation: 遊戲已經開始了！

scripts.text: Challenge it a little later.
scripts.translation: 請稍後再來挑戰。

scripts.text:
The destination displays with pressing the button after inserting the card.
It's above the deck in the middle of the island!
scripts.translation:
插入卡片並按下按鈕後，目的地就會顯示出來。
它在島嶼中央的甲板上！

scripts.text:
Beginning Compass among the Duruduru compass.
The Duruduru race starts from this compass.
scripts.translation:
這是嘟嘟羅盤中的起始羅盤。
嘟嘟比賽將從這個羅盤開始。

scripts.text:
After inserting the card and pressing the red button, the path to the destination lit up.
The order will be {0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
插入卡片並按下紅色按鈕後，通往目的地的路徑亮了起來。
順序是{0}^000000。

scripts.text: The order will be {0}^000000.

There is a strange machine.
This is the Duruduru compass from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
這是喵之勇氣隊的嘟嘟羅盤。

scripts.text:
Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
After inserting the card and pressing the button, characters appear on the screen.
scripts.translation:
精緻的{0}色燈光環繞著{1}。
插入卡片並按下按鈕後，螢幕上出現了字元。

scripts.text: Delicate {0} lights surround the {1}.
scripts.translation: 精緻的{0}色燈光環繞著{1}。

scripts.text: ^00FF00This is a card that didn't start the game yet. Please go back to the Beginning Compass.^000000
scripts.translation: ^00FF00這張卡片還沒有開始遊戲。請回到起始羅盤。^000000

scripts.text:
Welcome to the exciting number world!
Enter the exact answer after reading the question!
scripts.translation:
歡迎來到刺激的數字世界！
讀完題目後，請輸入正確答案！

scripts.text:
The card slides out with a sound after entering the number.
^4d4dffYou have passed the {0}! Run to the next destination!^000000
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
輸入數字後，卡片伴隨著聲音滑了出來。
^4d4dff你通過了{0}！快跑向下一個目的地！^000000
你應該跑向下一個目的地。

scripts.text:
You've got wrong answer!
You can not pass here without exact answer!
Enter exact answer after read question!
scripts.translation:
你答錯了！
沒有正確答案就無法通過這裡！
讀完題目後請輸入正確答案！

scripts.text:
The compass needle turns around in the middle of map.
You should run for the next destination.
scripts.translation:
羅盤的指標在地圖中央轉動。
你應該跑向下一個目的地。

scripts.text: ^FF0000You are going the wrong way! The paths in the card and compass don't line up!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000你走錯方向了！卡片和羅盤上的路徑不匹配！^000000

scripts.text:
There is a fancy bell which doesn't fit in with the ship.
This bell is used in a game by the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
有一個華麗的鈴鐺，與這艘船格格不入。
這個鈴鐺是喵之勇氣隊在遊戲中使用的。

scripts.text:
There is a one more little bell beside the huge notice bell in the deck.
This is the Meowbell from the Meow Bravery Team.
scripts.translation:
甲板上的巨大通知鈴旁邊還有一個小鈴鐺。
這是喵之勇氣隊的喵鈴。

scripts.text:
This is last bell to ring if you have the card for the game.
Nothing to say for now.
scripts.translation:
如果你持有遊戲卡片，這是最後一個需要敲響的鈴鐺。
目前沒什麼要說的。

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
Knock Meowbell!!
scripts.translation:
這是喵鈴。
將卡片插入中間的插槽。
敲響喵鈴！！

scripts.text:
This is the Meowbell.
You insert your card into the middle slot.
-- Beep --
The card has out with a warning sound.
scripts.translation:
這是喵鈴。
將卡片插入中間的插槽。
-- 嗶 --
卡片伴隨著警告聲滑了出來。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, I'm suprised.
You rang the Meowbell in a short time.
I think you have the talent to be an adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
哦，我很驚訝。
你在這麼短的時間內敲響了喵鈴。
我覺得你有成為冒險者的天賦。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
People say...
The purpose of this Duruduru game
is to find and go to a destination quickly and accurately.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
人們說...
這個嘟嘟遊戲的目的
是快速且準確地找到並前往目的地。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Go to Charo with that Adventure Card.
I will give you a confirmation stamp for success.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
拿著那張冒險卡片去找查羅。
我會給你蓋一個成功的確認章。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
Oh, you've really gotten used to it.
You succeeded again.
I've put my paw stamp here.
Run to Rato now.
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
哦，你真的已經熟練了。
你又成功了。
我在這裡蓋了我的爪印章。
現在去找拉托。

scripts.text:
[Deckhand Bubi]
You didn't ring the Meowbell within time.
Well, it's out of my hands now.
I will give you the fail stamp!!
scripts.translation:
[甲板水手 布比]
你沒有在規定時間內敲響喵鈴。
好吧，這不在我的控制範圍內了。
我會給你蓋一個失敗的章！！

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Hey, human adventurer, what are you here for?
Yeah~ this is a beautiful view.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嘿，人類冒險者，你來這裡做什麼？
嗯~ 這裡的風景真美。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Are you one of the people who came here to ring the Meowbell?
I am not a member of the Meow Team, but I can give you the confirmation stamp.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
你是那些來這裡敲喵鈴的人之一嗎？
我不是喵之隊的成員，但我可以給你蓋確認章。

scripts.text:
[Bubi]
Um, my work?
Oh, that is only for when I am not on a voyage.
I am free these days.
scripts.translation:
[布比]
嗯，我的工作？
哦，那只是在我不出航的時候做的。
這些天我很空閒。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Um? What is the matter?
Hey, here is a suspicious guy.
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
嗯？怎麼了？
嘿，這裡有個可疑的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
I can surely tell he is drunk by the smell of liquid.
I am so sad that I can not.
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
我肯定能通過液體的氣味判斷出他喝醉了。
真遺憾我不能。

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Oh, I am so sorry to hear that you have such genius analytical skills!
He is not drunk...
scripts.translation:
[偵探的朋友]
哦，聽到你有如此天才的分析能力，我很抱歉！
他沒有喝醉...

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Drunks always smell of liquid.
But he is not, therefore he is not drunk, friend.
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
醉漢總是有液體的氣味。
但他沒有，所以他沒有喝醉，朋友。

scripts.text: Then what is your identity?
scripts.translation: 那麼你的身份是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
Well... You are everything except drunk!!!
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
嗯... 你除了不喝醉之外，什麼都不是！！！

scripts.text: The voice of the cats sounded shaky.
scripts.translation: 貓的聲音聽起來有些顫抖。

scripts.text:
[Cat Detective]
What did I say?
Didn't I tell you that someone will come here soon?
scripts.translation:
[貓偵探]
我說了什麼？
我是不是告訴你很快會有人來這裡？

scripts.text:
[Friend of Detective]
Great.
I can only admire your deduction.
scripts.translation:
[偵探的朋友]
太好了。
我只能佩服你的推理能力。

scripts.text:
[Detective Homnya]
Haha, Nyangson, this is nothing for me.
Before that, let's listen to the stories from the visitor first.
scripts.translation:
[偵探 霍姆尼亞]
哈哈，喵森，這對我來說不算什麼。
在那之前，讓我們先聽聽來訪者的故事吧。

scripts.text: Charo? Rosy?
scripts.translation: 查羅？羅西？

scripts.text: Are you guys detectives?
scripts.translation: 你們是偵探嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
No... Who are they?
Nyangson, do you know them?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
不... 他們是誰？
喵森，你認識他們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I... I don't know either?
I don't know Charo and Rosy!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我... 我也不認識？
我不認識查羅和羅西！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes. Yes.
We are the detective and friend!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是的。是的。
我們是偵探和朋友！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I am the detective, Homnya.
And this is my friend, Nyangson. He reports my cases.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是的，我是偵探，霍姆尼亞。
這位是我的朋友，喵森。他負責報道我的案件。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Anyways, that's not important for now!
We should focus on current situation.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
總之，現在這不重要！
我們應該關注當前的情況。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, that's right, friend.
We think........
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
是的，沒錯，朋友。
我們認為........

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes! This is a bomb for sure!
I am so sorry, I have only analytical and detective skills but don't have the skill to dispose of a bomb!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是的！這肯定是個炸彈！
非常抱歉，我只有分析和偵探技能，但沒有拆除炸彈的技能！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
What do you mean by that?
It doesn't make any sense!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你這是什麼意思？
這完全說不通！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, we shout when it changed from the peak of hope into the peak of sorrow.
Peak!
Meow!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是的，當它從希望的頂峰變成悲傷的頂峰時，我們會大喊。
頂峰！
喵！

scripts.text: I don't get the meaning of this, but they seem to be in hurry.
scripts.translation: 我不明白這是什麼意思，但他們似乎很著急。

scripts.text: Continue to humor them.
scripts.translation: 繼續配合他們。

scripts.text: Stop playing around.
scripts.translation: 別胡鬧了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, if you give us a hand, I will take it. How do you think about it, friend?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
哦，如果你能幫把手，我會接受的。你覺得怎麼樣，朋友？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I don't really care about it. What I want to do is only to report this case.
One of the cases will be open to the public among the most strange and weird cases ever.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我其實不太在意。我想做的只是報道這個案件。
在那些最奇怪、最離奇的案件中，有一起將會向公眾公開。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew this visitor had the skill to dispose of a bomb.
He is totally prepared to escape from danger.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我知道這位來訪者有拆除炸彈的技能。
他完全做好了從危險中逃脫的準備。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Oh, I heard of it. I heard they use fly wings and butterfly wings as well.
I've never thought I could meet a person who used these thing for real.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
哦，我聽說過。我聽說他們也會使用蒼蠅翅膀和蝴蝶翅膀。
我從沒想過我會遇到一個真正使用這些東西的人。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, I believe this visitor will solve our mystery.
Then please stop this damn machine!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我相信這位訪客能解開我們的謎團。
那麼請停下這臺該死的機器！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, the damn machine!
It is loud and useless!
And it will be blown up.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
沒錯，就是那臺該死的機器！
它又吵又沒用！
而且它會被炸掉的。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Well, stop this machine!!!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
好了，停下這臺機器！！！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please don't...
Please act according to the script.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
請別這樣...
請按照劇本行動。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Charo. Where is the script?
No, Homnya. My friend...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
查羅。劇本在哪裡？
不，霍姆尼亞。我的朋友...

scripts.text: Two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻年輕的貓流了很多汗。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this noisy machine!
This is the moment that your memory can be coming through!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
停下這臺吵鬧的機器！
這是你的記憶即將浮現的時刻！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes. Yes.
This is the sort of training where you dispose of and breach all the traps.
Yes, this is.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
是的，是的。
這就是拆除並突破所有陷阱的訓練。
沒錯，就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It was a scary moment.
This machine is still fine anyways!
Stop it again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
剛才真是驚險。
不過這臺機器還是好好的！
再停一次。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, you need Adventure Card B to operate this machine.
Do you want to buy a new one?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是的，你需要冒險卡B來操作這臺機器。
你想買一張新的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It costs one Malangdo Can.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
它需要一個馬拉甘多罐頭。

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card.
scripts.translation: 購買冒險卡

scripts.text: Do not buy.
scripts.translation: 不買

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I said I can exchange Adventure Card with one Malango Can~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我說過可以用一個馬拉甘多罐頭兌換冒險卡~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
See, this is a scary machine.
Here is your Adventure Card.
Stop this machine this time.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
看，這是一臺可怕的機器。
這是你的冒險卡。
這次請停下這臺機器。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
What?
But you came here to buy a Adventure Card.
......
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
什麼？
但你來這裡是為了買冒險卡。
......

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
If you buy a Adventure Card there won't be any bloodshed...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
如果你買了冒險卡，就不會有流血事件了...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey, there is good news for you.
I received pretty good news while you struggled with that machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嘿，有個好訊息給你。
在你和那臺機器較勁的時候，我收到了相當不錯的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Hello, capable friend, what did you find?
Is this something like hidden treasure?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你好，能幹的朋友，你發現了什麼？
這是某種隱藏的寶藏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hidden treasure?
Very similar!
It will be hidden in serveral places inside the cabin.
You should find them!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
隱藏的寶藏？
非常相似！
它們會藏在船艙內的幾個地方。
你應該找到它們！

scripts.text: I feel tired of it now.
scripts.translation: 我現在覺得很累

scripts.text: Oh, yes!
scripts.translation: 哦，是的！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, really?
If you feel tired then it's okay.
Please come again, if you want.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
哦，是嗎？
如果你覺得累了也沒關係。
如果你願意，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please come again~.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew you would do this!
I have the right eye for people.
The place is inside of the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我就知道你會這麼做！
我識人的眼光很準。
地點在“Navi”號船的內部。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It will be fine because it isn't really a large place.
I look forward to your active work!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
不用擔心，那裡並不是很大的地方。
期待你積極的表現！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please find the pieces of the treasure.
The treasure is hidden inside of the ship Navi according to our information.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
請找到寶藏的碎片。
根據我們的情報，寶藏藏在“Navi”號船的內部。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Come here right after you find treasure!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
找到寶藏後馬上回來！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You've found all the treasure.
Yes, exactly.
You might thought this painting was just a normal painting.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
你找到了所有的寶藏。
沒錯，就是這樣。
你可能以為這幅畫只是一幅普通的畫。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
But...!
If we do this...!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
但是...！
如果我們這樣做...！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Oh, this is....... the one from that moment...
This is the one when we left our hometown.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
哦，這是....... 那一刻的......
這是我們離開家鄉時的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It's time to give it back to the brave new team!
Let's give it back!
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是時候把它還給勇敢的新團隊了！
讓我們把它還回去吧！
喵~

scripts.text:
Charo and Rosy who make up as Homnya and Nyangson
checked the pieces of painting and give it back again.
They look excited.
scripts.translation:
查羅和羅西扮成霍姆尼亞和喵森，
檢查了畫的碎片並再次將其歸還。
他們看起來很興奮。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please give it back to the Meow Bravery Team~
For everyone~ Meow~
These are real treasures!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
請把它還給“喵”勇氣隊~
為了大家~ 喵~
這些才是真正的寶藏！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Well? It's strange. There should be 6 pieces of treasure.
It's missing pieces...
Is this fake? I will throw it out!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嗯？這很奇怪。應該有6塊寶藏碎片。
缺少了一些碎片......
這是假的嗎？我要把它扔出去！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Go get the treasure again!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
再去把寶藏找回來！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Please give these treasures you've found to the Meow Bravery Team.
You will know how precious these treasures are when you give these to them~
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
請把你找到的這些寶藏交給“喵”勇氣隊。
當你把它們交給他們時，你就會知道這些寶藏有多珍貴~

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Yes, you will realize.
It's good to take a break for little bit but now we don't have any spare time.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
是的，你會意識到的。
稍微休息一下是好的，但現在我們沒有多餘的時間。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this noisy machine!
Insert your Adventure Card, and take a look at the reaction of the machine carefully. Then do the proper action!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
停止這臺吵鬧的機器！
插入你的冒險卡，仔細觀察機器的反應。然後採取正確的行動！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
That's right~
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
沒錯~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey Nyangson.
Here comes the hero.
He seems to be here for fixing this naughty machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嘿，喵森。
英雄來了。
他似乎是來修理這臺調皮的機器的。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I always admire your keen insight.
He looks like that for sure.
Then he will buy Adventure Card with Malangdo Can?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我一直很佩服你敏銳的洞察力。
他看起來確實像那樣。
那麼，他會用馬拉貢多罐頭買冒險卡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You are getting better
I always keep eyes on your keen insight.
You are my true friend.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
你越來越厲害了。
我一直關注著你敏銳的洞察力。
你是我真正的朋友。

scripts.text: How's the condition of Bang?
scripts.translation: 邦的情況怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
it's so motivated but it's not the time yet.
Not yet even though naughty machine is noisy.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
它很有幹勁，但現在還不是時候。
雖然那臺調皮的機器很吵，但還不是時候。
請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
We also have break time.....
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我們也有休息時間.....

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Can you hear how noisy this one is?
It sounds like a runaway foal!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
你聽到它有多吵了嗎？
聽起來像一匹脫韁的小馬！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
He needs an Adventure Card to stop it.
Well, do you want to try?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
它需要一張冒險卡才能停下來。
那麼，你想試試嗎？

scripts.text: Buy Adventure Card B.
scripts.translation: 購買冒險卡B

scripts.text: Don't buy it.
scripts.translation: 不購買

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
How many Malangdo Cans for an Adventure Card?
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
一張冒險卡需要多少罐馬拉貢多罐頭？

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Only one can, dear.
Meow~
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
只要一罐，親愛的。
喵~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, please try it without blowing it up.
Solve it fast!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是的，請試試，別把它弄炸了。
快點解決它！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please do it.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Ah... Hey... You can't do that!
Hey, don't go!
Please stop this, Nyangson!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
啊...嘿...你不能那樣做！
嘿，別走！
請停下來，喵森！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
This and that one are all noisy!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
這個和那個都很吵！
拜託了！

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻小貓流了很多汗。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Ah... Hey... You can't do that!
Hey, don't go!
Please stop this, Nyangson!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
啊...嘿...你不能那樣做！
嘿，別走！
請停下來，喵森！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
This and that one are all noisy!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
這個和那個都很吵！
拜託了！

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻小貓流了很多汗。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
I am a friend of Detective Homnya, Nyangson.
Please ask Homnya if you have questions.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我是偵探霍姆尼亞的朋友，喵森。
如果你有問題，請去問霍姆尼亞。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Yes, he only goes 'yes, my friend' beside me!
Ask me!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
是的，他在我身邊只會說“是的，我的朋友”！
來問我吧！

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
It has a Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green luminous body with buttons to react,
while spinning with noisy sounds.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
它有著紅、藍、黃、綠髮光的身體，還有用來反應的按鈕，
一邊發出嘈雜的聲音一邊旋轉。

scripts.text: It looks more unstable as it spins faster.
scripts.translation: 它轉得越快，看起來就越不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
It's so motivated, but it's not time yet.
Not yet, even though the machine is so noisy.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
它很有幹勁，但現在還不是時候。
雖然機器很吵，但還不是時候。
請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
We also have break time...
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
我們也有休息時間...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
You can't try this without Adventure Card B.
Please bring it with you.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
沒有冒險卡B是無法嘗試這個的。
請隨身攜帶它。

scripts.text:
There is a strange machine.
It has a Red, Blue, Yellow, and Green luminous body with buttons to react,
while spinning with noisy sounds.
scripts.translation:
有一臺奇怪的機器。
它有著紅、藍、黃、綠髮光的身體，還有用來反應的按鈕，
一邊發出嘈雜的聲音一邊旋轉。

scripts.text: It looks more unstable as it spins faster.
scripts.translation: 它轉得越快，看起來就越不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Stop this machine by inserting the card into it!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
將卡片插入機器中，讓它停止運轉！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Go ahead!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
請開始吧！

scripts.text: Insert card.
scripts.translation: 插入卡片

scripts.text: Stop it.
scripts.translation: 停下

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Um? You aren't going to do this?
Really?
Even though this machine can blow up the whole island?!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嗯？你不打算這麼做嗎？
真的嗎？
明明這臺機器可以炸掉整座島嶼啊？！

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Does he know it's never going to blow up?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
他知道它根本不會爆炸嗎？

scripts.text: The two young cats are sweating a lot.
scripts.translation: 兩隻小貓流了很多汗。

scripts.text:
After inserting the card, discs on top of the machine spin faster...
The lights begin to flicker faster too.
scripts.translation:
插入卡片後，機器頂部的圓盤旋轉得更快了...
燈光也開始閃爍得更快。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, great!
The banging has stopped!
You have a good memory!
Please take this small gift.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
太好了！
噪音停止了！
你的記憶力真不錯！
請收下這份小禮物。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
You can get it after you have been through all the difficulties from the Meow Advanture Team.
And we are not sure if this machine will try to blow up agian, so please come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
在你通過喵森冒險隊的所有難關後，就能獲得它。
而且我們不確定這臺機器明天是否還會嘗試爆炸，所以請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hey, there is good news for you.
I received pretty good news while you struggled with that machine.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
嘿，有個好訊息給你。
在你和那臺機器較勁的時候，我收到了相當不錯的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Hello, capable friend, what did you find?
Is this something like hidden treasure?
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
你好，能幹的朋友，你發現了什麼？
這是某種隱藏的寶藏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Hidden treasure?
Very similar!
It will be hidden in serveral places inside the cabin.
You should find them!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
隱藏的寶藏？
非常相似！
它們會藏在船艙內的幾個地方。
你應該找到它們！

scripts.text: I feel tired of it now.
scripts.translation: 我現在覺得很累

scripts.text: Oh, yes!
scripts.translation: 哦，是的！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Oh, really?
If you feel tired then it's okay.
Please come again, if you want.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
哦，是嗎？
如果你覺得累了也沒關係。
如果你願意，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
Please come again~.
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
歡迎再來哦~

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
I knew you would do this!
I have the right eye for people.
The place is inside of the ship Navi.
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
我就知道你會這麼做！
我識人的眼光很準。
地點在“Navi”號船的內部。

scripts.text:
[Nyangson]
It will be fine because it isn't really a large place.
I look forward to your active work!
scripts.translation:
[喵森]
不用擔心，那裡並不是很大的地方。
期待你積極的表現！

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Then I am looking forward to tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
那我期待明天了！

scripts.text:
Luminous
The order of buttons are:
[Red] [Green] [Blue] [Yellow]
And below this, more buttons:
[Green] [Red] [Yellow] [Blue]
In that order.
scripts.translation:
發光
按鈕的順序是：
[雷德] [綠] [藍] [黃]
在這個下面，還有更多按鈕：
[綠] [雷德] [黃] [藍]
按這個順序。

scripts.text:
Luminous
{0}
Shines according to this order.
The buttons below are shining now.
Stop the machine by pressing the right button within time.
scripts.translation:
發光
{0}
按照這個順序閃爍。
下面的按鈕正在發光。
請在時間內按下正確的按鈕來停止機器。

scripts.text:
Luminous
{0}
The buttons below are shining now.
Stop the machine by pressing the right button within time.
scripts.translation:
發光
{0}
下面的按鈕正在發光。
請在時間內按下正確的按鈕來停止機器。

scripts.text:
Luminous
The buttons below are shining now.
Stop the machine by pressing the right button within time.
scripts.translation:
發光
下面的按鈕正在發光。
請在時間內按下正確的按鈕來停止機器。

scripts.text: Which color button do you want to press {0}?
scripts.translation: 你想按下哪個顏色的按鈕 {0}？

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 紅色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 藍色

scripts.text: Yellow
scripts.translation: 黃色

scripts.text: Green
scripts.translation: 綠色

scripts.text:
The speed of spinning is getting faster after pressing the buttons.
After all...
scripts.translation:
按下按鈕後，旋轉的速度越來越快。
最後...

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Watch out!!!
 
[Nyangson]
It's blowing up!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
小心！！！

[喵森]
它要爆炸了！

scripts.text:
Adventure Card B burned off
with a huge explosion.
scripts.translation:
冒險卡B
在巨大的爆炸中燒燬了。

scripts.text:
The speed of the spinning discs gets slower after pressing the buttons.
The luminous shines once and stops also.
scripts.translation:
按下按鈕後，旋轉的圓盤速度變慢了。
發光閃爍一次後也停止了。

scripts.text:
[Homnya]
Don't reduce your tension!
It's not over yet!
scripts.translation:
[霍姆尼亞]
別放鬆警惕！
還沒結束呢！

scripts.text:
The machine starts again.
And the luminous shines also, as if it keeps asking you for the right answer.
scripts.translation:
機器再次啟動了。
指示燈也亮了起來，彷彿在催促你給出正確答案。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed in this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄太滿了，無法繼續此任務。 -

scripts.text:
{0}
You found a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你找到了一塊畫作的碎片。

scripts.text:
It looks like you can put these pieces of paintings together.
If I found all the pieces, I should go back to Homnya.
scripts.translation:
看起來可以把這些畫作碎片拼在一起。
如果找到了所有碎片，我應該回去找霍姆尼亞。

scripts.text:
I think this is the treasure Homnya and Nyangson mentioned.
Let's find more pieces.
scripts.translation:
我想這就是霍姆尼亞和喵森提到的寶物。
讓我們去找更多的碎片吧。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
What are you doing here?!
Don't touch that box any more!
There will be more bugs if you keep hiding snacks in there!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
你在這裡幹什麼？！
別再碰那個箱子了！
如果你繼續把零食藏在裡面，蟲子會越來越多的！
快出去！

scripts.text: A box in the corner of the cabin.
scripts.translation: 船艙角落裡有一個箱子。

scripts.text: This is a box which used to contain a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation: 這是一個曾經藏有畫作碎片的箱子。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
Ah, do not touch it!
Why do you keep messing it up after I clean up the room?!
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
啊，別碰它！
我打掃完房間，你為什麼又要弄亂？！
快出去！

scripts.text: The books are organized according to order on the bookshelf.
scripts.translation: 書架上的書是按順序排列好的。

scripts.text: This is a book which used to contain a piece of the painting.
scripts.translation: 這是一本曾經藏有畫作碎片的書。

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
What are you doing here?
Do not disturb me, and go away.
Get out!
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的船員]
你在這裡幹什麼？
別打擾我，走開。
快出去！

scripts.text:
It's dirty and smells like fish.
There are a lot of furs from cats.
scripts.translation:
很髒，而且有一股魚腥味。
上面有很多貓毛。

scripts.text:
This is dirty bed where a piece of the painting was hidden.
There are a lot of furs from cats.
scripts.translation:
這是一張曾經藏有畫作碎片的髒床。
上面有很多貓毛。

scripts.text: There is a seashell decoration on a clean display cupboard.
scripts.translation: 乾淨的展示櫃上有一個貝殼裝飾品。

scripts.text: This is the seashell where a piece of the painting was hidden.
scripts.translation: 這是一個曾經藏有畫作碎片的貝殼。

scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Is that you who scratched all the pillars in here?!
Meow~~~~!!
Get off from that pillar!
scripts.translation:
[皮奇船員]
是你把這裡的柱子都抓花了？！
喵~~~~！！
從柱子上下來！

scripts.text:
I can see the trace of a scratch.
Pillars made from trees are originally good to hang, but scratched by nails.
scripts.translation:
我能看到抓痕。
木頭做的柱子本來很適合攀爬，但被指甲抓花了。

scripts.text: I can see the crack where a piece of the painting was hidden.
scripts.translation: 我能看到曾經藏有畫作碎片的裂縫。

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A cold wind comes from these windows.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上有一些通風窗。
冷風從這些窗戶裡吹進來。
為什麼通風窗要裝在地板上？

scripts.text:
There are windows for ventilation on the floor.
A piece of the painting was hung in there.
Why are ventilation windows set up on the floor?
scripts.translation:
地板上有一些通風窗。
畫作碎片曾掛在裡面。
為什麼通風窗要裝在地板上？

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
Please clean up your stuff by yourself.
Especially you guys getting dirty after we came to this island!
Please throw the trash into the trash can.
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
請自己收拾好你的東西。
特別是你們，來到這座島之後弄得一團糟！
請把垃圾扔進垃圾桶。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
And you plucked every crop.
Hmph. Please, let's leave it in its natural state.
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
還有你們把作物都摘光了。
哼。拜託，請讓它們保持自然狀態。

scripts.text:
[Neat Crew]
What are you looking at?
Will you mess up here too?
Meow?!
scripts.translation:
[整潔的船員]
你在看什麼？
你也要在這裡搞破壞嗎？
喵？！

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
I try to be nice these days, and kids just take liberties with me.
Will you too?
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的船員]
我最近試著對人好一點，結果小孩們就對我為所欲為。
你也是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scary Crew]
They just come in and out, even the other person's room...
It causes harm for sure.
scripts.translation:
[嚇人的船員]
他們隨意進出，甚至進別人的房間...
這肯定會造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Picky Crew]
Do not run in the hall!
My fur falls out because of someone who
scratches everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[皮奇船員]
不要在走廊裡奔跑！
有人到處抓撓，我的毛都掉光了！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一隻看起來溫和的貓正在自言自語。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello... Mr. Cat...
The cat takes a glance at you and goes back to his whispering as if he didn't even see you.
scripts.translation: 那隻貓瞥了你一眼，然後繼續自言自語，彷彿根本沒看到你。

scripts.text: It seems you are not being considered worth talking to.
scripts.translation: 看來你覺得他不值得交談。

scripts.text: A gentle looking cat is whispering to himself.
scripts.translation: 一隻看起來溫和的貓正在自言自語。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Man! 10 losses in a row...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
天哪！十連敗了...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We are the 'Cat Gamers' Association.
But, we still keep on losing and we have no idea why!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我們是“貓玩家”協會。
但是，我們一直在輸，而且不知道為什麼！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We've got to find out the reason for this losing streak.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我們必須找出連敗的原因。

scripts.text: You are getting interested in the cat's story. Let's hear more.
scripts.translation: 你對這隻貓的故事產生了興趣。讓我們聽聽更多。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The reason, yes!
This can be one of them.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
原因，是的！
這可能是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
^DD2234Giving up so many points!^000000
That's right. No matter how much you score,
we will still lose if we give up so many points.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
^DD2234讓出這麼多分數！^000000
沒錯。無論我們得多少分，
如果我們讓出這麼多分，還是會輸。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
For the other reason. Hmm!
This could be related with the previous reason.
No ^DD2234aggresive point betting^000000 at all.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
至於另一個原因。嗯！
這可能與之前的原因有關。
完全沒有^DD2234激進的分數投注^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Other teams bet on games that they think will win, and bet low when they are not confident.
I guess we didn't know that.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
其他隊伍會投注他們認為會贏的比賽，並在不自信時投注較低。
我想我們不知道這一點。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hmm, can this be a reason?
For some reason there were ^DD2234players disappearing right before the match up^000000 and I guess this could have effected our game spirit.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嗯，這能是一個原因嗎？
不知為何，在^DD2234比賽前玩家會消失^000000，我想這可能影響了我們的比賽精神。

[貓玩家總監]
嗯...所以導致我們連敗的原因，
是讓出太多分數；
激進的分數投注；
以及玩家消失？

scripts.text: It seems like the gentle looking cat has finished thinking. Let's interrupt the conversion.
scripts.translation: 看起來這隻溫和的貓已經思考完畢。讓我們打斷這場對話。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now that I know the reason,
there should be a solution to that.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
既然知道了原因，
應該就有解決辦法了。

scripts.text: Umm... Mr. Cat...
scripts.translation: 那個...貓先生...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Who's there? Human? You are a human?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
誰在那裡？人類？你是人類？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
... ... ... ...

[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh! Yes! Right!
I remember hearing that
humans have started passing through here recently.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
哦！是的！沒錯！
我記得最近聽說
人類開始經過這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So good to see you!!
What is your name by the way?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
見到你真好！！
順便問一下，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}, Mr. Cat.

[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually I wanted to help you out since I heard that you've lost 10 games in a row...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實我想幫幫你們，因為我聽說你們已經連輸10場了...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, you didn't really have to point it out like that...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
哎呀，你不用特意指出來吧...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A weakness is no longer a weakness when you say it out loud.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一旦說出口，弱點就不再是弱點了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Hahahaha I like that phrase.
I should remember it and
tell it to my kids. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
哈哈哈，我喜歡這句話。
我應該記住它，
然後告訴我的孩子們。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I like you, {0} {1}. Will you help us get out of this 10 game losing streak? Ehehe~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我喜歡你，{0} {1}。你願意幫我們擺脫這10連敗嗎？嘿嘿~

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm a stupid {0}.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我是個愚蠢的{0}。

scripts.text: Sure, I'm a cool {0}.
scripts.translation: 當然，我是個很酷的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Guess I was wrong about you~
How can a person call themself stupid.
Now I can see how stupid you are.
Good bye~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
看來我看錯你了~
一個人怎麼能自稱愚蠢呢。
現在我看出來你有多蠢了。
再見~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Wow. I respect you, {0}.
Let me ask you a favor.
Please meet the hard working Manager Cat and ask about our team's attitude these days.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
哇。我很尊重你，{0}。
讓我求你個忙。
請去見見辛勤工作的管理員貓，問問我們團隊最近的態度。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
管理員貓應該就在這附近~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please meet the hard working
Manager Cat, and ask about our team's attitude these days.
The Manager Cat must be around here somewhere~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
請去見見辛勤工作的管理員貓，問問我們團隊最近的態度。
管理員貓應該就在這附近~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok Ok. So what did the manager cat say about the atmosphere these days?~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
好的好的。那麼管理員貓怎麼說最近的氣氛的？~

scripts.text: You tell him exactly what the Manager Cat said.
scripts.translation: 你原原本本告訴他管理員貓說了什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The manager cat said...

[Cat Gamers Director]
Do not hesitate... Just tell me everything~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
不要猶豫... 把一切都告訴我~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... the player cats are afraid of you...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯... 玩家貓們都很怕你...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What... What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
什... 你說什麼？

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家總監似乎受到了衝擊。讓我們給他一點時間冷靜一下。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock. Let's give him some time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家總監似乎受到了衝擊。讓我們給他一點時間冷靜一下。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
That is impossible!
There is no other cat that's nicer than I am!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
這不可能！
沒有比我更和藹的貓了！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Am I really that scary?
Are those players who bailed on the practice afraid of me too?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我真的那麼可怕嗎？
那些因為太累而逃跑的玩家，也是怕我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
It can't be, right? ehehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
不會吧，對吧？嘿嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text: - He laughs nervously. -
scripts.translation: - 他緊張地笑了起來。 -

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Is that the truth?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
這是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
{0}, will you help me out?
There are 4 players who ran away from practice saying they were too tired.
Could you check if they ran away because of me? ehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
{0}，你能幫幫我嗎？
有4名玩家說太累了，從練習中逃跑了。
你能查查他們是不是因為我才逃跑的嗎？嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
他們的名字是埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫。
他們應該就在這附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
請把他們全都找到~
但是，不要問得太直接！好嗎？
只是溫柔地問一些問題~
好嗎？要！溫柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
謝謝你的幫助，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It seems some humans are scamming cats around this town.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 看來有些人類在騙這個城鎮裡的貓。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What good is it to scam innocent cats?~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
騙無辜的貓有什麼好處呢？~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I think that you're right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我覺得你說得對。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Oh, so you met Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
It is so good to see you again. Heh~
Thank you very much for your effort~. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
哦，原來你見到了埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫。
很高興再次見到你。嘿~
非常感謝你的努力~。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So what did they say?
They really think I am scary?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
那他們怎麼說？
他們真的覺得我很可怕嗎？

scripts.text: You tell the Cat Gamers Director what Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff said.
scripts.translation: 告訴貓玩家總監埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫說了什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They think you push them too much through the practices. So they are scared.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們覺得你訓練時逼得太緊了。所以他們很害怕。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
What? Really?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
什麼？真的嗎？

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director seems to be shocked once again. Better give him more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家總監似乎再次受到了衝擊。最好給他多一點時間冷靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Their names are Eryu, Stew, Ketchup, and Eff.
They've got to be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
他們的名字是埃留、斯圖、番茄醬和埃夫。
他們應該就在這附近。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please find them all~
But, don't ask too directly! Ok?
Just ask them gentle questions~
Ok? Be! Gentle!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
請把他們全都找到~
但是，不要問得太直接！好嗎？
只是溫柔地問一些問題~
好嗎？要！溫柔！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I appreciate your help, {0}. heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
謝謝你的幫助，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director seems to be in shock once again. Better give more time to calm down.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家總監似乎再次受到了衝擊。最好給他多一點時間冷靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Ok, I understand.
I was a scary cat after all.
This can't be right!! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
好吧，我明白了。
看來我確實是一隻可怕的貓。
這不對啊！！嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I need to change my scary cat image. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我需要改變我可怕貓的形象。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is my mission now,
so our team can improve
game performance. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
這是我現在的使命，
這樣我們的隊伍才能
提升遊戲表現。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please go meet our manager cat,
and find out how can I change
this scary cat image of mine. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
請去見見我們的管理員貓，
問問怎樣才能改變
我這隻可怕貓的形象。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I would much appreciate your help, {0}~.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 我會非常感激你的幫助，{0}~。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Please ask our manager cat how can I change this scary cat image.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
請問問我們的管理員貓，怎樣才能改變我這隻可怕貓的形象。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please help me out,
{0}! Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 請幫幫我，
{0}！嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
You came back!! Heh~
So, what did our manager cat say?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
你回來了！！嘿~
那麼，我們的管理員貓怎麼說？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Manager cat asked to prepare a box.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
管理員貓讓我準備一個盒子。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
A box? Heh~ Sure, why not?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
一個盒子？嘿~ 當然，沒問題。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you going to ask me what is it for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你難道不問問這是用來做什麼的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Well, I kind of was eavesdropping when {0} and Manager Cat were talking together. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嗯，剛才{0}和管理員貓說話的時候，我有點在偷聽。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Now I need to check with our players, see how they really feel.
Heh~ Why don't you come back tomorrow?
Heh~ Let me decide what to do after checking their honest petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
現在我需要問問我們的玩家，看看他們真實的感受。
嘿~ 你明天再來吧？
嘿~ 等我看完他們真誠的請願信後再決定怎麼做。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Still receiving petition letters. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
還在接收請願信呢。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I wonder what they really want to say~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
不知道他們到底想說什麼呢~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ All done with collecting petition letters~
Heh~ Let's see what they wrote here?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 請願信收集完畢~
嘿~ 來看看他們都寫了什麼吧？

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在閱讀...~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Let me see... 'Stupid Cat lea...de...'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 讓我看看...“愚蠢的貓...莉亞...de...”

scripts.text:
- Crumpling the paper -
Cat Gamers Director has crumpled the paper and thrown it away.
scripts.translation:
- 揉皺紙張 -
貓玩家總監把紙揉成一團扔掉了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Wrong paper.
Let's read another one... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 拿錯紙了。
換一張看看... 嘿~

scripts.text: ~Reading~
