scripts.translation: ~正在閱讀~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Here we go.
'I don't like playing with the same team members over and over.
Please pick new team members,
or get me a practicing partner.'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 來了。
“我不喜歡總是和同一批成員組隊。
請給我換新的隊友，
或者找個練習搭檔。”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I see.
I can take this positively.
Heh~ Let's move on to another one.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 明白了。
這點我可以積極看待。
嘿~ 繼續看下一封。

scripts.text: ~Reading~
scripts.translation: ~正在閱讀~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'We need more snacks~ Get us some more snacks~'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~
“我們需要更多零食~ 多給我們點零食~”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ This one also sounds productive.
Heh~ Petition letters are good, I guess... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 這一封也很有建設性。
嘿~ 看來請願信還挺有用的... 嘿~

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在閱讀...~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
'Elders are bullying me. Help me...'
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~
“長老們在欺負我。幫幫我...”

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Our team is absolutely
like a family here~ Someone is
playing here, you know. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 我們的隊伍
絕對像一家人一樣~ 畢竟有人
在這裡玩耍嘛。嘿~

scripts.text: Reading...~
scripts.translation: 正在閱讀...~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ There are only 4 letters!
Including a prank one...
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 只有4封信！
其中還有一封惡作劇的...
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Everyone seems to have a satisfied team life~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
大家似乎都很滿意現在的隊伍生活~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not... Really...
There are tons of letters piled in the back of the box, but Cat Gamers Director doesn't want to admit the problem.
scripts.translation: 盒子後面堆著成堆的信，但貓玩家總監不想承認這個問題。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
Hey, {0}. What did you say? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~
喂，{0}。你剛才說什麼？嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nothing! Please carry on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒什麼！請繼續。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Because of what these players want,
I have a favor to ask you, {0}...
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 為了滿足這些玩家的要求，
我有個忙想請你幫一下，{0}...
嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is it?

[Cat Gamers Director]
Will you be our players' practicing partner?
Heh~ I feel strongly that you, {0}, can be trusted for this. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
你願意成為我們玩家的練習搭檔嗎？
嘿~ 我堅信你可以勝任，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text: No thanks, buddy!
scripts.translation: 不用了，朋友！

scripts.text: Ok, I'll do it!
scripts.translation: 好的，我答應！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Are you rejecting me? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 你是在拒絕我嗎？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
I'm sad. Sad~ Heh~
I didn't expect a refusal from a person like you, {0}.
But still, here's some coins for you~
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我好難過。難過~ 嘿~
沒想到會遭到像您這樣的人的拒絕，{0}。
不過，還是給您一些金幣吧~
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We will always welcome you, {0}, as a guest member of the Cat Gamers.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我們永遠歡迎您，{0}，作為貓玩家的貴賓成員。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 如果您改變主意了，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Good choice.
I knew you would help us Cat Gamers... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 好選擇。
我就知道您會幫助我們的貓玩家... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Thank you for your help.
Heh~ Here are some coins as a small gift... Heh~
Get yourself some goodies. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 感謝您的幫助。
嘿~ 這裡有一些金幣作為小禮物... 嘿~
去買點好吃的吧。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Since you will be our team's practicing partner, please come back in an hour.
Then I will give you our '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
既然您將成為我們隊伍的練習搭檔，請一小時內回來。
屆時我會給您'^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000'。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Ok, {0}. I will see you in an hour. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 好的，{0}。一小時後見。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~
Aren't you {0}?
Have you changed your mind yet?
Are you willing to be our team's practicing partner?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~
您是{0}嗎？
您改變主意了嗎？
您願意成為我們隊伍的練習搭檔嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm just passing through.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是路過。

scripts.text: I accept your offer.
scripts.translation: 我接受您的提議。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I see.
But, let me tell you once again, {0}.
You are always welcome to be one of our 'Cat Gamers Honorable Members'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 我明白了。
但是，讓我再告訴您一次，{0}。
您隨時都可以成為我們的'貓玩家榮譽成員'。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ At last!!
{0} will become our honorable member!!
I shall make a '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' right away. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 終於！！
{0}將成為我們的榮譽成員！！
我馬上為您製作'^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000'。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Come back in an hour and I will get you a '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000'.
Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
請一小時內回來，我會給您'^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000'。
嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ You want to get the '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' faster. Heh~ It's not really easy to get such a certificate easily.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 您想盡快拿到'^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000'。嘿~ 這種證書可不是那麼容易拿到的。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
So, it's a bit tricky... Heh~ Please come later. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
所以，有點麻煩... 嘿~ 請稍後再來。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I got a message from the workshop that their work on the certificate is done. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 我收到工坊的訊息，說證書已經做好了。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is not some ordinary certificate. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
這可不是普通的證書。嘿~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ This is...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 這是...

scripts.text: The Cat Gamers Director's eyes are shining with pride.
scripts.translation: 貓玩家總監的眼睛裡閃爍著自豪的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ The pure essence of the 'Cat Gamers' tech team's effort!!
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 這是'貓玩家'技術團隊努力的精華所在！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Equip this item, then all of your game playing records will be saved. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 裝備這個物品，你所有的遊戲記錄都會被儲存下來。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Take this and show us what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 拿著這個，讓我們看看你的實力。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I may be worrying too much... But, please wear this '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000', and play the game. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 我可能有點多慮了... 但是，請佩戴'^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000'，然後繼續遊戲。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
這不可能。請聯絡管理員。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hello, {0}. How is it going practicing with the players?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 你好，{0}。和玩家們的練習進展如何？

scripts.text: How are the players doing?
scripts.translation: 玩家們的情況如何？

scripts.text: Just stopped by to say hi~
scripts.translation: 只是順路打個招呼~

scripts.text: Here's the current status...
scripts.translation: 這是目前的情況...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Wow, {0}! I'm so touched by your care for the players.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 哇，{0}！你對玩家的關心讓我很感動。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ For 13 years of my life, I've never seen anyone like you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 在我13年的生命裡，我從未見過像你這樣的人，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ {0}, which player's condition are you interested in?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ {0}，你關心哪位玩家的情況？

scripts.text: Rock Paper Scissors players
scripts.translation: 猜拳玩家

scripts.text: ChamChamCham players
scripts.translation: ChamChamCham玩家

scripts.text: KongNyangKong players
scripts.translation: KongNyangKong玩家

scripts.text: Flag Game players
scripts.translation: 奪旗遊戲玩家

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Rock Paper Scissors players are missing practices occasionally, but they are still getting better. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 猜拳玩家雖然偶爾會缺席訓練，但他們的實力還是在穩步提升的。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
ChamChamCham players are actually complaining about the practice because you are doing so well with them, very hard to remember the winner. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
ChamChamCham玩家其實一直在抱怨訓練，因為您跟他們配合得太好了，贏的人很難記清楚。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ KongNyangKong players are so happy with the practice. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ KongNyangKong玩家對訓練感到非常滿意。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Flag Game players are always nervous since you make them work so much. Heh~ But, they are really getting better. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 奪旗遊戲玩家總是很緊張，因為您讓他們練得太辛苦了。嘿~ 不過，他們的進步確實很大。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please keep up the good work, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 請繼續保持這樣的表現，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hello there~ {0}. You have such good manners~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 你好呀~ {0}。您的禮儀真是好極了~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ These days, there are so many cats and humans without proper manners. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 最近，有很多貓和人類都不懂得基本的禮儀。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
We also have some of thme in our 'Cat Gamers'. They are so arrogant every time we win the game... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
我們“貓玩家”隊伍裡也有這樣的人。每次贏了比賽，他們就變得非常傲慢... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ There should be more people like you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 像您這樣有禮貌的人，{0}，應該再多一些才好。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Please practice with our players more often~ Heh~ So they can learn some manners from you, {0}. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 請多跟我們的玩家一起訓練~ 嘿~ 這樣他們就能向您學習一些禮儀了，{0}。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Keep up the good work~ Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
請繼續保持這樣的表現~ 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ What happened to your face, {0}? Guess you lost from the practice, right? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ {0}，您的臉怎麼了？看來是在訓練中輸了吧？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ I saw players puting notes in the 'Petition box'. Heh~ Guess that was your work. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 我看到有玩家在“請願箱”裡留了紙條。嘿~ 想必是您做的吧。讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It's not like I didn't feed them right... Heh~ I hope it was not too much for you, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 我並沒有虧待他們啊... 嘿~ 希望這些對您來說不算太麻煩，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hmm, 50 Marses, and 30 Milk Bottles... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 嗯，50個烏賊，還有30瓶牛奶... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Our team must have some grudge over Team 'Dog n Waltz', enough to ask you for this kind of favor...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 看來我們隊伍對“狗與華爾茲”隊伍很有意見，才會讓您幫忙辦這種事...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Ah, quickness training. It's good to see our players trying their best on training.
Heh~ Yes, nothing is better than mouse catching for improving quickness.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 敏捷訓練。看到我們的玩家如此努力訓練，真是好事。
嘿~ 沒錯，沒有什麼比抓老鼠更能提升敏捷度了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ '50 Peco Peco please!! Let's party.' Hmm... Heh~ 50 Pecos can feed all of our neighbors.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ “請給我們50只大嘴鳥！！我們要組隊。” 嗯... 嘿~ 50只大嘴鳥夠餵飽我們所有的鄰居了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Hmm... let me see... Heh~ That's right, I was worrying about our team getting so nervous before the actual game... But, they won't even talk to me about it.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 嗯... 讓我看看... 嘿~ 沒錯，我一直擔心大家在正式比賽前會太緊張... 但他們甚至都不願意跟我談論這件事。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ The note says, get me 30 Rat Tails for a snack.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 紙條上寫著，給我30根鼠尾當零食。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 5 on the note... 5 of what? What?! Lemons?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 紙條上寫著5... 5個什麼？什麼？！檸檬？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Give us 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams!! Heh~ I personally prefer Ice Cream, just so you know.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 給我們10個冰碎片或者10個冰淇淋！！嘿~ 順便告訴你，我個人更喜歡冰淇淋。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Here, I found the note from our team. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 這裡，我找到了我們隊伍留下的紙條。嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh?! There's no favor note for you, {0}. Heh~ What do you want to report? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿？！{0}，我這裡沒有你的委託紙條。嘿~ 你想報告什麼？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says in the note to bring 30 Phens and 10 Fish Tails. Heh~ Maybe you didn't catch enough Phens, or forgot some Fish Tails? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 紙條上寫著要帶30只劍魚和10條魚尾。嘿~ 也許你抓的劍魚不夠，或者忘了帶魚尾？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ But, where are 50 Marses and 30 Milk Bottles? Heh~ Please see if you haven't missed them...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 可是，50只烏賊和30瓶牛奶在哪裡？嘿~ 請檢查一下是不是漏掉了...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says on the note, harass 30 Kobold Archers. Heh~ Please check if you have harassed 30 of them already.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 紙條上寫著要騷擾30只犬妖弓箭手。嘿~ 請確認一下你是否已經騷擾了30只。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh? Where are those 10 Cramps you promised? Heh~ You didn't eat them... did you?
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿？你承諾的那10只藍鼠在哪裡？嘿~ 你不會...把它們吃了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those Peco Pecos? Still not ready? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 那些大嘴鳥在哪裡？還沒準備好嗎？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those 20 yarns? It says 20 on the note, right...? Please check if you have lost them somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 那20團毛線在哪裡？紙條上寫著20，對吧...？請檢查一下是不是弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are those 30 Rat Tails? Please check and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 那30根鼠尾在哪裡？請檢查一下，之後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Let's just get 5 Lemons for them, will you? Heh~ I am still not sure where they want to use them...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 那就給他們拿5個檸檬，好嗎？嘿~ 我到現在還不確定他們想拿檸檬做什麼...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Where are the Ice Pieces or Ice Creams? You should get them before they melt...
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 冰碎片或冰淇淋在哪裡？你應該在它們融化之前拿到...

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Eryu together.'. Heh~ Have you met Eryu already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 上面寫著“我們將一起會見埃留”。嘿~ 你已經見過埃留了嗎？我不覺得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Stew together.'. Heh~ Have you met Stew already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 上面寫著“我們將一起會見斯圖”。嘿~ 你已經見過斯圖了嗎？我不覺得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Ketchup together.'. Heh~ Have you met Ketchup already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 上面寫著“我們將一起會見番茄醬”。嘿~ 你已經見過番茄醬了嗎？我不覺得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ It says 'We will meet Eff together.'. Heh~ Have you met Eff already? I don't think so... Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 上面寫著“我們將一起會見埃夫”。嘿~ 你已經見過埃夫了嗎？我不覺得... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh?! There's no favor note for you, {0}. Heh~ What do you want to report? Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿？！{0}，我這裡沒有你的委託紙條。嘿~ 你想報告什麼？嘿~

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
{0}

scripts.text:
[Cat Gamers Director]
Heh~ Thanks for coming by, {0}. Heh~ Keep up the good work. Heh~
scripts.translation:
[貓玩家總監]
嘿~ 謝謝你來，{0}。嘿~ 繼續保持。嘿~

scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Strange Cat]
Meow~ Meo~ Ow Ow~ Meow Meo~ Eow Eow~
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的貓]
喵~ 喵嗚~ 嗷嗷~ 喵嗚喵嗚~ 嗷嗷~

scripts.text: Some strange cat is here.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一隻奇怪的貓。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Meo~ Ow Ow~ Meow Meo~ Eow Eow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
喵~ 喵嗚~ 嗷嗷~ 喵嗚喵嗚~ 嗷嗷~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你想幹什麼？

scripts.text: Ask about the team's attitude...
scripts.translation: 詢問團隊的態度...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Do not lie to me! How can I trust you and reveal our team secret? Aren't you a spy from the doggy team?
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
別騙我！我怎麼能信任你並透露我們團隊的秘密？難道你是狗隊派來的間諜嗎？

scripts.text: Aww, come on...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，別這樣...

scripts.text: You play with a foxtail nearby and then ask again.
scripts.translation: 你在附近玩弄貓尾草，然後再問一次。

scripts.text: Cat Gamers Director says...
scripts.translation: 貓玩家總監說...

scripts.text: The Manager Cat seems to be interested in the foxtail and starts answering.
scripts.translation: 管理員貓似乎對貓尾草很感興趣，開始回答你的問題。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Players are afraid of the Cat Gamers Director. When they see Cat Gamers Director at the game, they get nervous.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
玩家都很怕貓玩家總監。當他們在遊戲裡看到貓玩家總監時，都會變得緊張。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Can you give me that?
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你能把它給我嗎？

scripts.text: You hand the foxtail to the Manager Cat. Go back to the Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation: 你把貓尾草遞給管理員貓。回到貓玩家總監那裡。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie to me!
Why should I trust you,
and give our team information?
Aren't you a spy from doggy team...?
Go away.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
別騙我！
我為什麼要信任你，
並給出我們團隊的資訊？
難道你是狗隊派來的間諜...？
走開。

scripts.text: This cat might hit you.
scripts.translation: 這隻貓可能會攻擊你。

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
管理員貓正在玩你給他的貓尾草。
他似乎很喜歡...

scripts.text:
The Manager Cat is playing with the foxtail you gave him.
He seems to be liking it...
scripts.translation:
管理員貓正在玩你給他的貓尾草。
他似乎很喜歡...

scripts.text: Help~ Fire~
scripts.translation: 救命~ 著火了~

scripts.text: Hey~!
Do you want to hear something?
scripts.translation: 你想聽點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Don't lie~ We don't use fire that much~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
別騙人~ 我們不太用火~

scripts.text: The Manager Cat ignores you, and keeps on playing with the foxtail.
scripts.translation: 管理員貓無視了你，繼續玩著貓尾草。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ I want to tell you a story~ Follow me meow~ Let talk over there, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
喵~ 我想給你講個故事~ 跟我來喵~ 我們去那邊聊，喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Haha, I was just kidding. I actually need to tell you that the Cat Gamers Director has an issue...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈，我開玩笑的。其實我需要告訴你，貓玩家總監遇到了一些麻煩...

scripts.text: You explain the story to the Manager Cat.
scripts.translation: 你把事情經過講給了管理員貓聽。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scary image... Meow, I understand... Cat Gamers Director should feel peace by giving up things.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
可怕的景象... 喵，我懂了... 貓玩家總監應該通過放棄某些東西來獲得內心的平靜。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow! Go tell him this, meow~ Prepare a box, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
喵！去告訴他這個，喵~ 準備一個箱子，喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A box?

[Manager Cat]
Petition it is, meow!! There is some place where humans do such things, I think it will help us~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
就是請願箱，喵！！我記得人類有個地方是這麼做的，我覺得這能幫到我們~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, I will go tell it to the Games Director~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會去告訴遊戲總監~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You tell the Cat Gamers Director to prepare a Box for sure!~ I will tell this to my team, meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你務必告訴貓玩家總監準備一個箱子！~ 我會把這個訊息告訴我的團隊，喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The players are excited and writing a bunch of things for the petition box... I wonder what they are writing.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
玩家們很興奮，正在往請願箱裡寫很多東西... 我猜他們在寫什麼呢。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You won't help practice? If you help, the Cat Gamers Director will give you food cans... Please reconsider!
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你不幫忙練習嗎？如果你幫忙的話，貓玩家總監會給你罐頭吃的... 請再考慮一下！

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Meow~ Aren't you {0}? I heard Cat Gamers Director ordered a special certificate, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
喵~ 你不是{0}嗎？我聽說貓玩家總監訂購了一種特殊的證書，喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When practicing, you must equip the '^0000FFCat Gamers Certificate^000000' item~ Don't forget, meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
練習時，你必須裝備'^0000FF貓玩家證書^000000'這個物品~ 別忘了，喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
這不可能。請聯絡管理員。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What do you want meow?
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你想做什麼喵？

scripts.text: Hi.
scripts.translation: 你好。

scripts.text: Any news?
scripts.translation: 有什麼新聞嗎？

scripts.text: Help me with playing.
scripts.translation: 幫我玩遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh, hi meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
哦，你好喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
I tell you this meow~ You don't know Cat Gamers Director's feeling meow~.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
我告訴你喵~ 你不知道貓玩家總監的感受喵~。

[Manager Cat]
lol? >> Curious, Admire
Heh~ >> Normal
lol Heh~ >> Happy
lol lol Heh~ >> Crazy meow
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
哈哈？>> 好奇，羨慕
嘿嘿~ >> 普通
哈哈 嘿嘿~ >> 開心
哈哈 哈哈 嘿嘿~ >> 瘋狂喵

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
But, why are you asking me meow? Strange meow...
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
但是，你為什麼問我喵？真奇怪喵...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Some cats use 'meow meow' like me when talking, but some don't.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
有些貓像我一樣說話時會用“喵喵”，但有些貓不會。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Cats don't have an honorific phrase, so don't get us wrong as looking down on you meow.~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
貓沒有敬語，所以請不要誤會我們是在輕視你喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should walk around many places and ask for information meow... But, don't bother me please meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你應該去很多地方打聽訊息喵... 但是，請不要打擾我喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
No easy way for that... I just breathe meow...
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
沒有什麼簡單的辦法... 我只是呼吸喵...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
What game do you want to play?
'Cat Gamers' has players for 4 types of games meow~
The Cat Gamers Director said he will challenge other games later~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你想玩什麼遊戲？
“貓玩家”有4種遊戲的玩家喵~
貓玩家總監說之後會挑戰其他遊戲~

scripts.text: Rock Paper Scissors
scripts.translation: 石頭剪刀布

scripts.text: KongNyangKong
scripts.translation: KongNyangKong

scripts.text: ChamChamCham
scripts.translation: ChamChamCham

scripts.text: Flag Game
scripts.translation: 旗子游戲

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Rock Paper Scissors meow? Nothing special...
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
石頭剪刀布喵？沒什麼特別的...

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Scissor beats Paper, meow.
Rock beats Scissors, meow.
Paper beats Rock, meow.
These are basic rules.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
剪刀贏紙張，喵。
岩石贏剪刀，喵。
紙張贏岩石，喵。
這些是基本規則。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You play 5 Rock Paper Scissors games with player cats meow.
You play again when you are even meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你和玩家貓進行5局石頭剪刀布喵。
平局時重新進行喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can get a present after 3 times of winning meow.
And you get a big present when you win all 5 matches, meow!!
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
贏3次可以獲得禮物喵。
贏下全部5局，可以獲得大禮物，喵!!

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Find Paa or Ser if you want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
如果你想玩石頭剪刀布遊戲，去找帕阿或塞爾。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
KongNyangKong is not an easy game meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
KongNyangKong不是簡單的遊戲喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When attacking, face your hand the same direction as the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
攻擊時，手的方向要與對手相同喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
When defending, you should face your hand the opposite direction from the opponent meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
防禦時，手的方向要與對手相反喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If the attack is a success, you can keep on attacking.
But, if you fail, you have to defend meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
如果攻擊成功，你可以繼續攻擊。
但是，如果失敗，你就必須防禦喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you be careful, you can win without getting hit at all meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
如果你小心一點，完全可以做到毫髮無傷地獲勝喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Once you make your opponent's HP 0, you win meow.
Of course there will be a present meow.
Good luck meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
一旦將對手的HP降為0，你就贏了喵。
當然會有禮物喵。
祝你好運喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Oh~ right meow~!! Find KungKung if you want to play KongNyangKong.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
哦~對了喵~！！如果你想玩KongNyangKong，去找孔孔。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
ChamChamCham is a high level mind game meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
ChamChamCham是一款高難度的心理博弈遊戲喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
The rules are simple, but you need to think a lot meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
規則很簡單，但需要動很多腦筋喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You should direct your hand to where the cat turns its face meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你應該將手伸向貓臉轉過去的方向喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
A present is given for 3 wins in a row meow.
The more wins, the more presents meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
連續獲勝3次即可獲得禮物喵。
獲勝次數越多，禮物越多喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Kuka is smart, and remembers players with many wins meow.
There will be more presents when you take 1st place meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
庫卡很聰明，會記住獲勝次數多的玩家喵。
獲得第一名時會有更多禮物喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
Flag Game is way harder than ChamChamCham game meow.
Really~ Really~ Really~
hard mind game meow.
It's 1,000 times harder meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
旗子游戲比ChamChamCham難得多喵。
真的~真的~真的~
是非常燒腦的心理博弈喵。
難度是它的1000倍喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You get 5 Flag Point when starting meow.
1 point goes away when you wave the flag once meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
開始時你有5點旗子點數喵。
每揮動一次旗子，就會失去1點喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You win the game when no other cats are waving flags meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
當沒有其他貓在揮動旗子時，你就贏了喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You can predict if other cats will wave their flags or not meow.
By looking at their actions meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
你可以通過觀察其他貓的動作，
來預測它們是否會揮動旗子喵。

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
You must win to get presents meow.
You will get more presents since this is hard game meow~
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
必須獲勝才能獲得禮物喵。
因為這是高難度遊戲，所以禮物會更多喵~

scripts.text:
[Manager Cat]
If you want to play Flag Game meow~
Go find the other manager cat who is trying to get the Referee Certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[管理員貓]
如果你想玩旗子游戲喵~
去找那隻正在嘗試獲取裁判證書的另一隻管理員貓喵。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text: You found Eryu the cat, and start talking.
scripts.translation: 你找到了貓埃留，並開始交談。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm... Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯...你是誰？

scripts.text: The Games Director sent me.
scripts.translation: 遊戲總監派我來的。

scripts.text: I am a writer for the 'Human' magazine.
scripts.translation: 我是《人類》雜誌的記者。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Arrgg. Go away...
I don't know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
啊...走開...
我不知道你在說誰。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Umm? 'Human' magazine?
Is there such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯？《人類》雜誌？
有這種東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We've been publishing for 10 years.
But, I guess it is possible for cats to not know who we are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們已經出版10年了。
不過，貓不知道我們是誰，也是有可能的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We are a really famous magazine throughout the World!
Don't you believe me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們是全世界都非常有名的雜誌！
你不相信我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Hmm... ok. But, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯...好吧。不過，我能為你做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am in the middle of writing an article named 'Game Playing Cats'...'
It is a special piece for me.
And some team named umm... do... umm... wal... not sure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正在寫一篇名為《遊戲玩家貓》的文章...
這是對我來說非常特別的一篇。
還有一個隊伍，名字是...嗯...多...嗯...華爾...不確定...

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
'Dog n Waltz'?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
“狗與華爾茲”？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Yes!
One of players there 'Dog n Waltz' has recommended Eryu for an interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！是的！
“狗與華爾茲”的一名玩家推薦了埃留接受採訪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He says you are a really good player who can help me with the article.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他說你是一位非常優秀的玩家，可以幫我完成這篇文章。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
I don't remember anyone from 'Dog n Waltz' that much.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
我不太記得“狗與華爾茲”的任何人了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The person isn't important.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個人不重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just answer a few questions for me, ok?
Be yourself and you'll do just fine.
Ok, first question: How much do you practice a day?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只要回答我幾個問題就好，好嗎？
做你自己，你會做得很好的。
好，第一個問題：你每天練習多久？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Usually for about 8 hours, but I have to tell you that I'm not on the team anymore...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
通常大約8個小時，但我必須告訴你，我不在那個隊伍了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, what?
You are not with the team now? How come...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，什麼？
你現在不在隊伍裡了？怎麼會...？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Well...
The Director Cat was too scary...
I was very sick and had to take a day off...
Just one freaking day...
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
嗯...
總監貓太可怕了...
我病得很重，不得不請了一天假...
就一天而已...

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
And then the Director Cat was raging at me!
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
然後總監貓對我大發雷霆！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm, sounds pretty rough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，聽起來挺糟糕的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
'Cat Gamers' has lost another great player.
I'm sorry to hear that you're not on the team anymore.
I guess this is the end of the interview.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
“貓玩家”又失去了一位優秀的玩家。
很遺憾聽到你不在隊伍裡了。
我想採訪到此為止了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because this is for current players only.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因為這是隻針對現役玩家的。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Oh...
Sorry to make you waste your time.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
哦...
抱歉讓你浪費了時間。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, don't worry.
I should say sorry for taking up your precious time.
Have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，別擔心。
應該說抱歉佔用你寶貴的時間。
祝你有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
You found out the reason why Eryu left the team.
Time to go find the other cats.
scripts.translation:
你發現了埃留離開隊伍的原因。
是時候去找其他貓了。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Yes, I am Eryu! What do you want, huh, meow~
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
是的，我是埃留！
你想幹什麼，喵~

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Aren't you the magazine writer?
What brings you here again...?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你不是那個雜誌記者嗎？
怎麼又來這裡了...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah!
Sorry, I was trying to interview another cat...
And came back to you by mistake.
I'm sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！
抱歉，我本來想採訪另一隻貓...
結果不小心走到你這裡來了。
對不起。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Ah... I see. Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
啊...我知道了。保重。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
This is not possible. Please contact an administrator.
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
這不可能。請聯絡管理員。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你是誰？

scripts.text: What do you want to say?
scripts.translation: 你想說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
What is this? What do you mean by '{0}'...?
Ah... aren't you the writer?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
這是什麼？你說“{0}”是什麼意思...？
啊...你不是那個記者嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh... Who is that..?

Eryu seems to recognize you.
{0}
scripts.translation:
埃留似乎認識你。
{0}

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
I think you are the writer...
Hey~ Stop there~
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
我想你就是那個記者...
嘿~ 站住~

scripts.text: You've been found. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 你被發現了。快逃吧。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Dirty 'Cat Gamers'!
I won't go back ever... Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
骯髒的“貓玩家”！
我絕不會回去...你是誰？

scripts.text: This cat might hit you. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 這隻貓可能會攻擊你。快逃吧。

scripts.text:
[Eryu]
Aren't you the writer?
scripts.translation:
[埃留]
你不是那個記者嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh... Who is that..?
Eryu seems to recognize you. Let's get away.
scripts.translation: 埃留似乎認識你。快逃吧。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text: You found Stew the cat, and start talking.
scripts.translation: 你找到了貓斯圖，並開始交談。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Meow...? Who are you, meow?
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
喵...？你是誰，喵？

scripts.text: The 'Cat Gamers' Manager sent me.
scripts.translation: “貓玩家”的管理員派我來的

scripts.text: Meow~ Grrr~
scripts.translation: 喵~ 嗚嗚~

scripts.text: I'm with the 'Boom Can' Company.
scripts.translation: 我是“Boom Can”公司的。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Stew is not interested meow.
Don't come back again meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
斯圖沒興趣喵。
別再來了喵~

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Stew doesn't have time for crazy people.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
斯圖沒空理瘋子。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
'Boom Can' Company, meow?
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
“Boom Can”公司，喵？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You don't know 'Boom Can' food?
You don't eat canned food at all?
Then, I came to the wrong cat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你不知道“Boom Can”的食物嗎？
你完全不吃罐頭嗎？
那我找錯貓了。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Yes meow~ Stew likes canned food very much meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
是的喵~ 斯圖很喜歡罐頭喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! Ok then.

[{0}]
We, the 'Boom Can' Company, have been servicing for over 10 years, so we are doing a survey for better food production.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們“Boom Can”公司已經服務了10多年，所以正在進行調查，以改進食品生產。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me ask a few questions.
It is very easy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我問幾個問題。
非常簡單。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Ok meow~ Go ahead meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
好的喵~ 請講喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you! We were right about out cat customers with big hearts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝！我們果然沒看錯，貓顧客們都有大愛心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met dog customers last week and they didn't answer me at all...
And they were so rude~ You know.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
上週我遇到了狗顧客，它們完全不理我...
而且非常無禮~ 你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Dogs are natually like that~
You humans know animals~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
狗天生就這樣~
你們人類瞭解動物~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you! I'm flattered.~
Ok, let me ask you a few things.
What is your job?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝！我很榮幸~
好的，讓我問你幾個問題。
你的職業是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Job meow? Stew was a pro gamer meow~
But, Stew quit now meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
職業喵？斯圖以前是職業玩家喵~
但是，斯圖現在退隱了喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, how did that happen?
You seem to have good skills.
Fast and big hearted, its a pity that you quit already.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那是怎麼回事？
你看起來技術很好。
速度快，心腸又好，可惜已經退隱了。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Meow~ Meow~ Meow~ Yes, Stew was something meow.
If it was not for that Cat Gamers Director scaring me, Stew would still be playing meow~
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
喵~ 喵~ 喵~ 是的，斯圖曾經很厲害喵。
如果不是那個貓玩家總監嚇唬我，斯圖還會繼續玩喵~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What a bad Director.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真是個壞總監。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Not that bad actually meow~
Sometimes.. Stew gets very tired meow.
So, Stew takes it easy while practicing meow.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
其實沒那麼壞喵~
有時候...斯圖會很累喵。
所以，斯圖練習時會放鬆一點喵。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Then the Cat Gamers Director started to get angry and scary meow.
So I quit meow.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
然後貓玩家總監開始生氣，嚇了斯圖一跳喵。
所以斯圖就退隱了喵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah! I see.
Ok, the survey is over now.
Thank you for your opinion on our survey for the 'Boom Can' company.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！我明白了。
好的，調查到此結束。
感謝您對“Boom Can”公司調查的意見。

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Meow? Did you aks anything meow?
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
喵？你問了什麼喵？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I already asked you everything...
Don't you remember?
There were 10 questions!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經問了你所有的問題...
你不記得了嗎？
一共有10個問題！

scripts.text:
[Stew]
Really meow? Strange meow.
Sorry meow? Don't remember meow.
It didn't felt like an interview meow.
scripts.translation:
[斯圖]
真的喵？真奇怪喵。
抱歉喵？不記得了喵。
感覺不像是在採訪喵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well you did way better than those dogs.
I don't even want to think about them~ Phew~..
I should get going now.
Have a great day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，你比那些狗強多了。
我甚至不想去想它們~ 呼~..
我該走了。
祝你有美好的一天。

scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
猜拳是一項嚴肅的遊戲。我們的練習搭檔什麼時候來呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game?

[Ser]
Where is your Cat Gamers Certificate? It seems like nothing, but you can't play this game without it!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你的貓玩家證書呢？雖然看起來沒什麼，但沒有它你是不能玩這個遊戲的！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please go get the certificate.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
請去把證書拿來。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Is it tomorrow already? I don't think so! Can't you read the time?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
已經明天了嗎？我不覺得！你難道不會看時間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game?
Play the game.
scripts.translation: 玩遊戲

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good idea.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
好主意。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! Ok, hi? But, why now?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！好的，你好？但是，為什麼是現在？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... You are bored? Why don't you play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
啊...你是無聊了嗎？不如跟我玩個遊戲吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hey, you! Don't neglect the Rock Paper Scissors game!!
I've seen many people getting their butts kicked in this game!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
嘿，你！不要輕視猜拳遊戲！！
我見過很多人在這個遊戲中被打得落花流水！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You better mark my words, if you don't want to end up like them!~
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你最好記住我的話，如果你不想像他們一樣慘的話！~

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You don't even know how to play this game?
Let me kindly teach you.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你連這個遊戲怎麼玩都不知道嗎？
讓我好好教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Scissors beats Paper,
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
剪刀勝紙張，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Paper beats Rock,
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
紙張勝岩石，

scripts.text:
[Ser]
And Rock beats Scissors.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
而岩石勝剪刀。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok? Got it now?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
明白了嗎？懂了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You must play 5 matches with me.
We go again if the game is even!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你必須和我玩5局。
如果是平局，我們就再玩一次！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I will give you a present if you beat me 3 times. Ok?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
如果你贏我3次，我會送你一份禮物。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ok, then. Go away.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
好了，就這樣。快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Result is even, so we play again.
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
第{0}局 ~~
結果是平局，所以我們要再玩一次。
加油哦！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} match ~~
Try your best!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
第{0}局 ~~
加油哦！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾與{0}]
石頭！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石頭

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Ser]
All 5 matches are over!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
5局全部結束了！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm... Let me see...
I won {0} times, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
嗯...讓我看看...
我贏了{0}次，而你，{1}，贏了{2}次，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has won the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
{0}贏得了比賽。

scripts.text: Ser became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 塞爾突然變得很有禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Great game it was. I admire your enthusiasm for the game. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
真是場精彩的比賽。我很欣賞你對遊戲的熱愛。所以，我想把我珍貴的罐頭作為禮物送給你。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Just take it!! Do as I say~
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
拿著吧！！照我說的做~

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You are polite. But, sadly this is all I can give you.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你很禮貌。但遺憾的是，我只能給你這些了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
Oh! You won all 5 matches. Here are some more extra Cans.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
再見~ 明天再來練習吧~
哦！你贏了全部5局。這裡還有一些額外的罐頭。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Good bye~ Come back tomorrow for more practice~
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
再見~ 明天再來練習吧~

scripts.text:
[Ser]
{0} has lost. Ha... Ha...
Ser became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 塞爾變得非常傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You want to play with me? Ser? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你想跟我玩？塞爾？就憑你那點本事？喵？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What? Present? How can you ask for such a thing when you lose? Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
什麼？禮物？輸了還想要禮物？去多練習！！努力！！沒錯，我應該讓你這麼做！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
嗯。你知道一種叫劍魚的魚嗎？知道吧？看起來很好吃吧？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Ser wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕嚕 -
塞爾擦掉了嘴邊的口水。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Go catch 30 Phens. And also get me 10 Fish Tails. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
去抓30條劍魚。再給我弄10個魚尾。把它們交給我們的貓玩家總監，他會用它們做一道美味佳餚。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me. I should take care of my health.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
最近，我感到力不從心，肩上的擔子太重了。我應該好好保養一下身體。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Now it's time for some healthy food.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
現在是吃點健康食物的時候了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
去抓50只烏賊和25瓶牛奶，交給我們的貓玩家總監。他對健康食品很有研究。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Well... we do have a rival, you know. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
嗯...我們有個對手，你知道嗎。他們是“狗與華爾茲”，只要他們出現，一切都會變得一團糟。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal... So, please at least harass similar looking monsters. What would be a good target?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我想讓你去欺負他們，但我想那可能違法...所以，請至少去騷擾一下長得像他們的魔物。什麼目標比較合適？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦，就是刺錘犬妖裡的弓箭手！！我最討厭那種了。去騷擾30只犬妖弓箭手，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
What is most important for winning the game? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
贏得比賽最重要的是什麼？是速度。我們要怎麼做才能變得更快？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I've been thinking... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我一直在想...對我們貓來說，最好的方法顯然是抓老鼠。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
You know Cramp, right? That blue chubby creature... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
你知道藍鼠嗎？那種藍色的胖傢伙...請去抓10只，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Ah... I want some bird cuisine. Which one would be most delicious?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
啊...我想吃些鳥類料理。哪一種最好吃呢？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Picky? Ah! It's too small. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
小雞？啊！太小了。禿鷹呢？我不太確定...大嘴鳥？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Alright! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
好！請去抓50只大嘴鳥，交給我們的貓玩家總監。今晚我們要舉辦一場鳥類料理派對。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I get too nervous before the game. And I don't play well when I'm nervous. I need something to calm down before the game starts.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我在比賽前總是太緊張了。一緊張就發揮不好。我需要找點東西，在比賽開始前讓自己冷靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! That's right! Yarn! I used to play with Yarn when I was young. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers'.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！對了！毛線球！我小時候經常玩毛線球。加入“貓玩家”之後，就沒再享受過那種放鬆的感覺了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 20 Yarns for me. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue. Our Director should take care of this for you.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
請幫我拿20個毛線球。為什麼是20個？因為有很多隻貓都有同樣的困擾。我們的總監應該會為你處理這件事的。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses. Or is the manager taking advantage?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
最近，我們的總監似乎一直在試圖削減開支。還是說管理員在趁機佔便宜？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我們選手的常規零食被削減了。你應該去拿30條鼠尾，然後交給我們的貓玩家總監。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
這樣，我們就能看看我們的管理員是不是在貪小便宜了。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I am having a slump these days. I can't give my 100% to the game.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我最近狀態很差。沒辦法在遊戲中發揮100%的實力。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
It is the lemon we need in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
在這種時候，我們需要的是檸檬。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get 5 lemons for me. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
請幫我拿5個檸檬。別忘了，我需要5個檸檬...我們的貓玩家總監應該知道該怎麼處理它們。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets very hot when we play games.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
瑪朗多是個適合貓咪居住的好地方。但是，當我們玩遊戲的時候，會變得非常熱。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
當我們玩得投入時，真的會變得熱得發瘋，讓人難以忍受。你知道我們貓咪有多情緒化吧？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Please get us either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
請幫我們拿10個冰碎片或者10個冰淇淋。我們的貓玩家總監應該知道該怎麼處理它們。

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我看你也需要休息一下。不妨放鬆一會兒。要不要在村子裡散散步？我強烈建議哦~！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
但是，只是在村子裡散步也沒什麼意思。嗯...對了！！你不妨去見見一隻名叫埃留的貓？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！還有，當你見到那隻貓時，一定要說“回來”。那是密碼。別忘了告訴我們的總監，我一直都在你身邊！！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
I can see that you also need some rest. Feel free to relax for a while. How about taking a walk around the village? I insist~!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
我看你也需要休息一下。不妨放鬆一會兒。要不要在村子裡散散步？我強烈建議哦~！

scripts.text:
[Ser]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Stew?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
但是，只是在村子裡散步也沒什麼意思。嗯...對了！！你不妨去見見一隻名叫斯圖的貓？

But, it is no fun to just walk around the village. Hmm... Right!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Ketchup?
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
但是，只是在村子裡散步也沒什麼意思。嗯...對了！！你不妨去見見一隻名叫番茄醬的貓？

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
但是，只是在村子裡散步也沒什麼意思。嗯...對了！！你不妨去見見一隻名叫埃夫的貓？

scripts.text:
[Ser]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back'. That is the password. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time!!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾]
哦！還有，當你見到那隻貓時，一定要說“回來”。那是密碼。別忘了告訴我們的總監，我一直都在你身邊！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You haven't done what we asked you for meow. A promise is a promise, you know meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你還沒有完成我們拜託你的事情喵。一諾千金，你懂的喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When you are done meow, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
做完之後喵，請去那邊找貓玩家總監檢查一下喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You seem like a first timer meow! Where did you get the certificate meow? Someone lost it, I guess meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起來像是第一次來喵！你的證書是從哪裡弄來的喵？大概是有人弄丟了吧喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When is our practicing partner coming meow? I am bored meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我們的練習搭檔什麼時候來喵？我無聊死了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000喵？想玩猜拳遊戲嗎喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Where is your Cat Gamers Certificate meow? It seems like nothing, but you can't play this game without it meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你的貓玩家證書呢喵？雖然看起來沒什麼，但沒有它可玩不了這個遊戲喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go get the certificate meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去把證書拿來喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We can only play the game once a day meow. Come tomorrow meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我們每天只能玩一次喵。明天再來喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, ^0000FF{0}^000000 meow? Want to play the Rock Paper Scissors game meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，^0000FF{0}^000000喵？想玩猜拳遊戲嗎喵？

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 玩遊戲

scripts.text: Say hi.
scripts.translation: 打招呼

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good idea meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好主意喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hello meow~ Nice to see you meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你好喵~ 見到你真好喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Other games have one cat player. But, we have two for Rock Paper Scissors. You want to know why meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
其他遊戲只有一隻貓玩家。但是，我們猜拳遊戲有兩隻。你想知道為什麼嗎喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Paa is kind meow. So, I'll tell you story meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
帕阿很善良喵。所以，我要給你講個故事喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Ser cat is my twin brother. I was born first, but he always says he is the elder meow. But, I don't fight with Ser meow. I am a good brother meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
塞爾貓是我的雙胞胎哥哥。雖然我是先出生的，但他總說他是哥哥喵。不過，我不跟塞爾吵架喵。我是個好哥哥喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Anyways, me and Ser are well known as the pro gamer cat brothers meow. Everyone knows us meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
總之，我和塞爾是著名的職業遊戲貓兄弟喵。大家都認識我們喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are free to admire me, meow. I give you permission meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你可以隨意崇拜我，喵。我允許你喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to know how to play this game meow? I'll teach you because I am a kind cat meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你想知道怎麼玩這個遊戲嗎喵？我會教你的，因為我是隻善良的貓喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You don't seem that stupid meow. So, let's skip the part about what beats what meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你看起來不笨喵。所以，我們跳過“誰贏誰”的部分喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You must play 5 matches with me meow. We go again if the game is even meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你必須和我玩5局喵。如果平局，我們就再玩一次喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
If you win 3 times, I'll give you a present meow~ Cat Gamers Director said so meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
如果你贏了3次，我會給你一份禮物喵~ 貓玩家總監是這麼說的喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
That is all meow~ But it is not an easy game meow. Respect the game meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
就這些喵~ 但這可不是個簡單的遊戲喵。請尊重遊戲喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Result is even, so we play again meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局 ~~ 喵。
結果是平局，所以我們要再玩一次喵。
加油喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
{0} match ~~ meow.
Try your best meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
第{0}局 ~~ 喵。
加油喵！

scripts.text:
[Ser & {0}]
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
scripts.translation:
[塞爾與{0}]
石頭！剪刀！布！

scripts.text: Rock
scripts.translation: 石頭

scripts.text: Paper
scripts.translation: 布

scripts.text: Scissors
scripts.translation: 剪刀

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Meow!! All 5 matches are over meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
喵！！5局全部結束了喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Let me see meow...
I won {0} times meow, and you, {1}, won {2} times, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
讓我看看喵...
我贏了{0}次喵，你，{1}，贏了{2}次，對吧喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You won meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你贏了喵。

scripts.text: Paa became polite all of a sudden.
scripts.translation: 帕阿突然變得很有禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Great game it was meow. I admire your enthusiasm for the game meow. So, I want to give you my precious Can as a present meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
真是精彩的一局喵。我很欣賞你對遊戲的熱愛喵。所以，我想把我珍貴的罐頭作為禮物送給你喵。

scripts.text: I don't need it!
scripts.translation: 我不需要！

scripts.text: Thank you.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Just take it meow!! Do as I say meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
快拿去吧喵！！照我說的做喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You are polite meow. But, sadly this is all I can give you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你很禮貌喵。但是，很遺憾，這就是我能給你的全部了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
Oh! You won all 5 matches meow. Here are some more extra Cans meow!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再見喵~ 明天再來練習喵~
哦！你贏了全部5局喵。這裡有一些額外的罐頭喵！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Good bye meow~ Come back tomorrow for more practice meow~
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
再見喵~ 明天再來練習喵~

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You lost. Meow... Meow...
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你輸了。喵... 喵...

scripts.text: Paa became very arrogant.
scripts.translation: 帕阿變得非常傲慢。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You want to play with me? Paa? With that skill of yours? Meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你想和我玩？帕阿？就憑你那點技術？喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What? Present meow? How can you ask for such a thing meow? You lost meow! Go practice more!! Work!! Yes, I should make you do this meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
什麼？禮物喵？你怎麼能提出這種要求喵？你輸了喵！去多練習！！努力！！是的，我應該讓你做這個喵！！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Hmm. Do you know a fish named Phen meow? Do you? Isn't it a delicious looking fish meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
嗯。你知道一種叫劍魚的魚嗎喵？知道吧？那看起來是不是很好吃喵？

scripts.text:
- Chrub -
Paa wipes the drool from his mouth.
scripts.translation:
- 咕嚕 -
帕阿擦掉了嘴邊的口水。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Go catch 30 Phens meow. And also get me 10 Fish Tails meow. Get them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去抓30條劍魚喵。還要給我弄10個魚尾喵。把它們交給我們的總監貓，他會用它們做一道美味佳餚喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Lately, I've felt powerless and that there's too much weight on me meow. I should take care of my health meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近，我覺得自己很無力，感覺肩上的擔子太重了喵。我應該好好照顧一下我的健康喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Now it's time for some healthy food meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
現在是吃健康食物的時間了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 50 Marse and 25 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director meow. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
去抓50只烏賊和25瓶牛奶，交給我們的貓玩家總監喵。他對健康食品很有研究喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
We do have a rival, you know meow. They are 'Dog n Waltz', and everything goes wrong when they come around meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你知道吧，我們有個對手喵。他們叫“狗與華爾茲”，只要他們一齣現，事情就會變得一團糟喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I would ask you to bully them, but I suppose that's illegal meow... So, I will ask you to harass similar looking monsters meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我想讓你去欺負他們，但這好像違法喵... 所以，我會讓你去騷擾一些長得像他們的魔物喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh, that archer among Kobolds meow!! I hate those the most. Go harass 30 Kobold Archers, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦，就是刺錘犬妖裡的那個弓箭手喵！！我最討厭那種了。去騷擾30只犬妖弓箭手，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
What is most important for winning the game meow? It is quickness. What should we do to get faster meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
贏得比賽最重要的是什麼喵？是速度。那我們要怎麼做才能變快呢喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I've been thinking meow... The best way for us cats is obviously catching rats meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我一直在想喵... 對我們貓來說，最好的方法顯然是抓老鼠喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
You know Cramp, right meow? That blue chubby creature meow... Please go catch 10 of them, and report to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
你知道藍鼠吧喵？就是那種藍色的胖乎乎的生物喵... 請去抓10只，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Chrub... I want some bird cuisine meow. Which one would be most delicious meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
咕嚕... 我想吃點鳥類料理喵。哪一種最好吃呢喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Picky? Ah! It's too small meow. How about Condor? I am not sure... Peco Peco meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
小雞？啊！太小了喵。禿鷹怎麼樣？我不太確定... 大嘴鳥喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Alright meow! Please catch 50 Peco Pecos and get them to our Cat Gamers Director meow. We shall have a party with bird cuisine tonight meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
好喵！請抓50只大嘴鳥，交給我們的貓玩家總監喵。今晚我們要舉辦一場鳥類料理派對喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I get too nervous before the game meow. And I don't play well when I'm nervous meow. I need something to calm down before the game starts meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
比賽前我總是太緊張喵。而且我一緊張就發揮不好喵。我需要在比賽開始前吃點東西讓自己冷靜下來喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! That's right meow! Yarn meow! I used to play with Yarn when I was young meow. Wasn't able to have that kind of relaxation after joining the 'Cat Gamers' meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！對了喵！毛線喵！我小時候經常玩毛線喵。加入“貓玩家”之後，就沒法享受那種放鬆了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Please get 20 Yarns for me meow. Why 20? There are many other cats with the same issue meow. Our Director should take care of this for you meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
請幫我弄20個毛線球喵。為什麼是20個？因為有很多貓都有同樣的困擾喵。我們的總監應該會為你處理這件事喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Recently, our Director seems to have been trying to cut some expenses meow. Or is the manager taking advantage meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
最近，我們的總監似乎想削減一些開支喵。還是說管理員在佔便宜喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Regular snacks for our players have been reduced meow. You should go get 30 Rat Tails, and give them to our Cat Gamers Director meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
給我們玩家的日常零食被減少了喵。你應該去弄30個鼠尾，交給我們的貓玩家總監喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Then, we shall find out if our manager is being greedy or not meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
然後，我們就能看看我們的管理員是不是在貪小便宜了喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I am having a slump these days meow. I can't give my 100% to the game meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
這些天我狀態很差喵。沒辦法在賽場上發揮100%的實力喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
It is the lemon we need in times like this meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
在這種時候，我們需要的是檸檬喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get 5 lemons for me meow. Don't forget, I need 5 Lemons meow... Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
幫我弄5個檸檬喵。別忘了，我要5個檸檬喵... 我們的貓玩家總監應該知道該怎麼處理它們喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live meow. But, it gets very hot when we play games meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
瑪朗多是個適合貓居住的好地方喵。但是，當我們玩遊戲的時候，那裡會變得非常熱喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
When we are playing a lot, it gets really crazy hot, hard for us to bear meow. You know how hysterical we cats can be, right meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
當我們玩得興起的時候，真的會變得超級熱，讓我們難以忍受喵。你知道我們貓有多瘋狂吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Get me either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them meow.
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
給我弄10個冰碎片或者10個冰淇淋喵。我們的貓玩家總監應該知道該怎麼處理它們喵。

scripts.text:
[Paa]
I can see that you also need some rest meow. Feel free to relax for a while meow. How about taking a walk around the village meow? I insist meow~!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
我看你也需要休息一下喵。不妨放鬆一會兒喵。去村裡散散步怎麼樣喵？我強烈建議喵~！

scripts.text:
[Paa]
But, it is no fun to just walk around the village meow. Hmm... Right meow!! Why don't you go ahead and meet a cat named Eryu meow?
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
但是，只是在村裡散步也沒什麼意思喵。嗯...對了喵！！你不妨去見見一隻名叫埃留的貓喵？

scripts.text:
[Paa]
Oh! And when you meet the cat, make sure to say 'Come back' meow. That is the password meow. And don't forget to tell our Director I was with you all the time meow!!
scripts.translation:
[帕阿]
哦！見到那隻貓的時候，記得說“回來”喵。那是密碼喵。還有，別忘了告訴我們的總監，我一直都在你身邊喵！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You haven't done what we asked you for yo~. A promise is a promise, you know yo~.
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
你還沒做我們讓你做的事喲~。答應過的事情就要做到喲~。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
When you are done, please get checked by the Cat Gamers Director over there yo.~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
做完之後，請去那邊找貓玩家總監檢查一下喲~。

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
You seem like a first timer yo~ Where did you get the certificate yo~ You better give that back yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
你看起來像是第一次來喲~ 證書是從哪裡弄來的喲~ 最好把它還回去喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
The Cat Gamers Director said a practicing partner is coming yo~ But, that human didn't show up yo~ I am bored yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
貓玩家總監說有個練習搭檔要來喲~ 但是，那個人類沒有出現喲~ 我好無聊喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
哦，偉大的成員，^0000FF{0}^000000~ 我們來玩ChamChamCham吧喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
But, you don't have the certificate yo~ Certificate helps you save the game record yo~ You must have it! yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
但是，你沒有證書喲~ 證書可以幫你儲存遊戲記錄喲~ 你必須要有它！喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Please go get the certificate yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
請去拿證書喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Is it not tomorrow yet yo~ You can play one game a day yo~ Come back tomorrow yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
現在還沒到明天喲~ 你每天只能玩一局喲~ 明天再來喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Oh great member you, ^0000FF{0}^000000~ Let's play ChamChamCham yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
哦，偉大的成員，^0000FF{0}^000000~ 我們來玩ChamChamCham吧喲~

scripts.text: Play the game.
scripts.translation: 玩遊戲

scripts.text: Ask who is 1st place.
scripts.translation: 詢問誰是第一名

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Good choice yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
不錯的選擇喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
No one holds a record for the ChamChamCham game yo~
You could be the first yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
目前還沒有人保持ChamChamCham遊戲的記錄喲~
你可以成為第一個喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
Never know when someone else would break the record yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
目前ChamChamCham遊戲的第一名是
^0000FF{0}^000000，連勝^DE2B21{1}^000000場喲~
不知道什麼時候會有人打破紀錄喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Current 1st place for the ChamChamCham game is
^0000FF{0}^000000 with ^DE2B21{1}^000000 winning streak yo~
I expect that you, {2}, can beat ^0000FF{3}^000000 sometime yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]
目前ChamChamCham遊戲的第一名是
^0000FF{0}^000000，連勝^DE2B21{1}^000000場喲~
我相信你，{2}，總有一天能打敗^0000FF{3}^000000喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
ChamChamCham game rules are very simple yo~
Just direct your hand towards the direction where I direct my face yo~
scripts.translation:
[庫卡]

[庫卡]

[庫卡]

他對健康飲食很有研究喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]

[庫卡]

[Kuka]

[庫卡]

scripts.text:
[Kuka]
Catch 10 blue and chubby Cramps, and report to our Cat Gamers Director yo~

[庫卡]

scripts.text:
[Kuka]

[庫卡]

scripts.text:

[庫卡]

抓50只大嘴鳥，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報喲~

scripts.text:
[Kuka]

[庫卡]

我需要在比賽開始前吃點東西讓自己冷靜下來喲~

[Kuka]

scripts.text: Ask current 1st place.

scripts.text: Ask about the game rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問遊戲規則

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Before the game, we will decide the turn by rolling a dice.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
比賽開始前，我們要通過擲骰子來決定先後手。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Why do you want to know the 1st place? KongNyangKong is a brutal and tough match game. Kuka should know such thing!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你為什麼想知道第一名？孔羊孔是一場殘酷且激烈的比賽。庫卡應該知道這一點！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You want to learn the game rules?
You seem to have a polite way of asking things.
Listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你想學習遊戲規則？
你提問的方式很有禮貌。
請仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
KongNyangKong has different play rules when attacking and defending.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
孔羊孔在進攻和防守時有不同的規則。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
When attacking, you must turn your hand to the same side as your opponent in order to complete the attack.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
進攻時，你必須將手轉向與對手相同的方向，才能完成進攻。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If we turn our hands the same way like this, then your attack is successful.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
如果我們像這樣把手轉向同一方向，那麼你的進攻就成功了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
For defending, you must turn your hand to the opposite side of your opponent in order to defend yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
防守時，你必須將手轉向與對手相反的方向，才能進行防守。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Yes! If you turn your hand opposite to mine like that, you have succeeded defending yourself.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
沒錯！如果你像那樣把手轉向與我相反的方向，你就成功防守了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
If you are clever enough, you should know that the bottom hand is the attacker's hand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
如果你足夠聰明，你應該知道下面的手是進攻方的手。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Last!! Most important rule.
Once you succeed attacking, you can continue attacking your opponent.
When you fail, then you are on the defending side.
Do not forget this!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
最後！！最重要的規則。
一旦你進攻成功，就可以繼續進攻對手。
如果你失敗了，你就轉為防守方。
別忘了這一點！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
You can ask about the KongNyangKong rules anytime you want!
Our Manager Cat also knows all about the KongNyangKong rules.
That is all!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
你可以隨時詢問孔羊孔的規則！
我們的管理員貓也精通孔羊孔的規則。
就這些了！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Come again tomorrow. I will beat you next time.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
明天再來吧。下次我會打敗你的。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I won. It was a boring match.
You need to practice more. Maybe some extra work will help.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我贏了。這是一場無聊的比賽。
你需要多練習。也許做些額外的工作會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch the delicious fish Phen.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去抓美味的劍魚吧。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Go catch 30 Phens. And also get me 10 Fish Tails. Give them to our Director cat, and he will make a delicious dish with them.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去抓30條劍魚。還要給我弄10個魚尾。把它們交給我們的貓總監，他會用它們做一道美味的菜餚。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I may have worked out too much... I feel powerless and that there's too much weight on me. I should take care of my health.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我可能鍛鍊過頭了...我覺得渾身無力，身上好像壓著很重的東西。我應該注意一下健康。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I am already 10 years old, so it's time for some healthy food.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我已經10歲了，是時候吃點健康的食物了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 50 Marse and 30 Milk to our Cat Gamers Director. He has excellent knowledge on healthy foods.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去給貓玩家總監弄50個烏賊和30瓶牛奶。他對健康食品有著豐富的知識。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
We have a rival. The 'Dog n Waltz' team... Everything goes wrong when they come around.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我們有個對手，就是“狗與華爾茲”隊...每次他們一來，事情就會變得一團糟。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I want to ask you to bully them, but that's illegal...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我想讓你去欺負他們，但那是違法的...

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Go harass 30 Kobold Archers instead of 'Dog n Waltz', and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去騷擾30個犬妖弓箭手代替“狗與華爾茲”，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Quickness is most important for winning the game. For better quickness...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
敏捷是贏得比賽的關鍵。為了提升敏捷...

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catching mice is best. It's Cramp hunting time.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓老鼠是最好的辦法。現在是獵殺藍鼠的時間了。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 10 Cramps, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓10只藍鼠，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I want some bird cuisine. Have you tasted any before?
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我想吃些鳥類料理。你以前嘗過嗎？

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Peco Peco sounds delicious to me. I don't like eating alone, so...
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
大嘴鳥聽起來很美味。我不喜歡一個人吃，所以...

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Catch 50 Peco Pecos, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. We all can have a dinner party with Peco Peco cuisine.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
抓50只大嘴鳥，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。我們可以一起享用大嘴鳥料理的晚宴。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Being calm is the key to winning important matches.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
保持冷靜是贏得重要比賽的關鍵。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
There's not a single cat who hasn't played with Yarn when they were young.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
沒有哪隻貓小時候沒玩過毛線球。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 20 Yarns, and report to our Cat Gamers Director. It will help improve our team's ability.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
弄20個毛線球，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。這有助於提升我們隊伍的能力。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
I have a strong belief that our Manager Cat is taking advantage of our snacks.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我堅信我們的管理員貓在偷吃我們的零食。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
All we need is evidence... Get 30 Rat Tails, and report to our Cat Gamers Director.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我們只需要證據...弄30個鼠尾，然後向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Then, we shall find out whether or not Manager Cat was doing something wrong.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
這樣，我們就能查明管理員貓是否做了壞事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Practice was ok, but I seem to be having a slump these days.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
練習還過得去，但我最近似乎陷入了低谷。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
We need to have some Lemon in times like this.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
在這種時候，我們需要一些檸檬。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get 5 Lemons to our Cat Gamers Director. He'll know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
弄5個檸檬給我們的貓玩家總監。他會知道該怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Malangdo is a good place for a cat to live. But, it gets hot easily.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
馬拉多是個適合貓居住的好地方。但是，那裡很容易變熱。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
On a hot days like this, we could use some Ice Pieces or Ice Cream.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
在這樣炎熱的日子裡，我們需要一些冰碎片或冰淇淋。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Get either 10 Ice Pieces or 10 Ice Creams. Our Cat Gamers Director should know what to do with them.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
弄10個冰碎片或10個冰淇淋。我們的貓玩家總監應該知道該怎麼處理它們。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我們的貓玩家總監提出了這個要求。我應該讓你去辦這個差事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Eryu the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去馬拉多找到貓埃留，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後，你可以向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我們的貓玩家總監提出了這個要求。我應該讓你去辦這個差事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Stew the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去馬拉多找到貓斯圖，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後，你可以向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Our Cat Gamers Director asked this. I should make you do this errand.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我們的貓玩家總監提出了這個要求。我應該讓你去辦這個差事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Ketchup the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去馬拉多找到貓番茄醬，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後，你可以向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
我們的貓玩家總監提出了這個要求。我應該讓你去辦這個差事。

scripts.text:
[KungKung]
Find Eff the cat from Malangdo, and say 'Come back' loud and clear.
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
去馬拉多找到貓埃夫，大聲清楚地對他說“回來”。

scripts.text:

Afterwards, you can report to our Cat Gamers Director. Off you go!!
scripts.translation:
[孔孔]
之後，你可以向我們的貓玩家總監彙報。快去吧！！

scripts.text: Your inventory is too heavy to proceed. Come back after lightening your load.
scripts.translation: 您的負重太重，無法繼續。請減輕負重後再來。

scripts.text: Your inventory is too full to proceed. Come back after reducing your load.
scripts.translation: 您的背包已滿，無法繼續。請整理背包後再來。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are done with your assigned work.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
除非你完成了分配的工作，否則你不能挑戰這場旗幟塗鴉遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Not everyone can challenge just because they have the certificate.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
不是每個人只要有證書就可以挑戰的。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Ok, let's practice until a challenger comes!!
scripts.translation:
[首領]
好的，讓我們練習，直到有挑戰者到來！！

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Do you want to challege?
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你想挑戰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You cannot challenge this Flag Game unless you are wearing our certificate item. Please come back later.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
除非你佩戴了我們的證書物品，否則你不能挑戰這場旗幟塗鴉遊戲。請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
The Flag Game is only available once a day.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
旗幟塗鴉遊戲每天只能進行一次。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Do you want to challege?
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你想挑戰嗎？

scripts.text: Challenge.
scripts.translation: 挑戰

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Ask about the rules.
scripts.translation: 詢問規則

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Let's challenge the Flag Game. Please wait while our cats get prepared.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
讓我們來挑戰旗幟塗鴉遊戲。請等待，我們的貓正在準備。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Oh! I retired from 'Cat Gamers', and am working on a national game referee license. Licenses are the new trend these days.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
哦！我從“貓玩家”退役了，正在考取國家級遊戲裁判執照。執照是現在的趨勢。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
A referee must use standard language... So it was very hard for me to stop crying meow meow~ like other cats.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
裁判必須使用標準語言... 所以對我來說，停止像其他貓那樣喵喵叫是非常困難的。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
I know the game rules for players for sure, but refereeing the game is a lot harder than it seems.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
我肯定知道玩家的遊戲規則，但裁判比賽比看起來要難得多。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Sometimes I do make mistakes, and people go crazy like it's the end of world. What a hard job this is.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
有時候我確實會犯錯，然後大家就像世界末日一樣發瘋。這工作真難啊。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
But, I want to finish this course, and be the world's best referee ever.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
但是，我想完成這個課程，成為有史以來最偉大的裁判。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You can bet on it!!
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你可以相信我！！

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Allow me to explain the rule for the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
請允許我解釋一下旗幟塗鴉遊戲的規則。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You play with 5 other cats.
Wait and wave the flag when no others are waving it.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你和另外5只貓一起玩。
等待，並在沒有其他貓揮動旗幟時揮動你的旗幟。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You start with 5 Flag Points, and each time you wave the flag 1 point vanishes.
When your points hit 0, the game ends.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你從5點旗幟點數開始，每次揮動旗幟會減少1點。
當點數歸零時，遊戲結束。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
There's a special rule for this Flag Game. For more thrill, we reduce 1 point if you do not wave your flag for 10 games.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
這個旗幟遊戲有一條特殊規則。為了增加刺激感，如果你連續10局沒有揮動旗幟，將扣除1點。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
You will get bigger presents as you win with less Flag Points used.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
你獲勝時使用的旗幟點數越少，獲得的禮物就越大。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Come back anytime if you need more help with the game rules. Our Manager Cat is also available for some help with the game rules.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
如果你需要更多關於遊戲規則的幫助，隨時回來。我們的管理員貓也可以提供遊戲規則方面的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Cats are now all prepared.
What will you do?
 
Tip: ^F86A08{0}^000000
scripts.translation:
[首領]
貓們現在都準備好了。
你要做什麼？

但是！這是揮旗遊戲，所以這不算數。

由於你在10局中都沒有揮動旗幟，根據官方揮旗遊戲規則，將扣除1點旗幟點數。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Congratulations. You have won the Flag-Waving Game.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
恭喜。你贏得了揮旗遊戲。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
But, only 3 Canned Foods will be given as the present since you didn't take a big part through the game.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
不過，由於你在遊戲中參與度不高，只贈送3罐罐頭食品作為獎品。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Congratulations. You have won the Flag-Waving Game. {0} Canned Foods will be given as the present.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
恭喜。你贏得了揮旗遊戲。將贈送 {0} 罐罐頭食品作為獎品。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Hope you win some more Canned Foods tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[首領]
希望明天你能贏得更多罐頭食品。

scripts.text:
[Leader]
Flag waving failed...
... ... ... ...
Leader gives you a note without hesitation. You must follow the order now.
scripts.translation: 首領毫不猶豫地遞給你一張紙條。你現在必須服從命令。

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I'm hungry. Any rats wandering around?
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
啊~我餓了。有沒有老鼠在附近遊蕩？

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Ah~ I think I could eat 100 cramps at once.
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
啊~我覺得我一次能吃100只藍鼠。

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Hey, why don't you look around? Who knows? Maybe we can find a delicious canned food~
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
嘿，你為什麼不四處看看呢？說不定能找到美味的罐頭食品~

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
Then, you can give me one. Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
然後，你可以給我一罐。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Seichi]
I am hungry~ Any leftover canned food there?
scripts.translation:
[誠一]
我餓了~有沒有剩下的罐頭食品？

scripts.text:
[Row]
Hut! Human, you came to see me, Row the Great? What? No?
scripts.translation:
[羅]
嘿！人類，你是來看偉大的羅的嗎？什麼？不是？

scripts.text:
[Row]
What do want then? Get lost. Ah...!!
scripts.translation:
[羅]
那你想要什麼？滾開。啊...!!

scripts.text:
[Row]
You want to play the Flag Game? I see. Show me what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[羅]
你想玩旗子游戲？我明白了。讓我看看你的本事。

scripts.text:
[Row]
But, you know you can never beat me, the great Row.
scripts.translation:
[羅]
但是，你知道你永遠贏不了偉大的羅。

scripts.text:
[Row]
Flag waving is a serious game. Only special cats like me can compete. Meow~
scripts.translation:
[羅]
揮舞旗子是一項嚴肅的遊戲。只有像我這樣的特殊貓才能參加。喵~

scripts.text:
[Debong]
Hair picking is my best hobby meow.
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
拔毛是我最喜歡的愛好喵。

scripts.text:
[Debong]
When picking hair meow~
Time really flies meow~
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
拔毛的時候喵~
時間過得真快喵~

scripts.text:
[Debong]
Come here, you, meow. I'll pick your hair meow.
scripts.translation:
[德邦]
過來，你，喵。我要拔你的毛喵。

scripts.text: The cat is picking your hair.
scripts.translation: 貓正在拔你的毛。

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Arrgg!! Why should I play this stupid flag waving game here?
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
啊...!! 為什麼我要在這裡玩這種愚蠢的揮旗遊戲？

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Hey you. What do you think? I know you've hearing me!
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
嘿，你。你在想什麼？我知道你在聽！

scripts.text:
[Libs]
Well, I'm sure you won't have a clue why this is happening. I forgive you.
scripts.translation:
[利布斯]
好吧，我確信你根本不知道這是怎麼回事。我原諒你了。

scripts.text:
