scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Wow Wot~ What a busy day~
Oh, you are the one who won the honorable certificate?
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
哇哦~ 真是忙碌的一天~
哦，你就是那位獲得榮譽證書的人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
There are more orders coming every day. Ahh!! Give me some more manpower!!
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
每天的訂單都越來越多。啊啊！！給我多派點人手！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Certificate complete!!
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
喵~ 哦~ 證書完成！！

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I already gave your certificate to the Cat Gamers Director! Go check it out~
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
我已經把你的證書交給貓玩家總監了！去看看吧~

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Please... Keep this wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
請...無論去哪裡都帶著它。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I am a cat. Nyah~ Ong~
I look like a sheep because I was so busy I didn't have time to shave.
It is not my fault...
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
我是一隻貓。喵~ 哦~
我看起來像只羊，是因為太忙了沒時間刮毛。
這不是我的錯...

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
Nyah~ Ong~ Do not interrupt my resting.
Usually, I am very busy...
Don't touch me.
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
喵~ 哦~ 不要打擾我休息。
平時，我非常忙碌...
別碰我。

scripts.text:
[Uneet]
I'm a bit fat now, but you should look at yourself too. Haha...
scripts.translation:
[烏尼特]
我現在有點胖了，但你也要看看你自己。哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
I want join 'Cat Gamers'.
But it seems the Cat Gamers Director is busy now. Should I just leave?
scripts.translation:
[面試貓]
我想加入“貓玩家”。
但看起來貓玩家總監現在很忙。我該直接離開嗎？

scripts.text:
[Interview Cat]
What? You also want join this group?
scripts.translation:
[面試貓]
什麼？你也想加入這個組織？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
Why did someone put that vase inside of a glass?
The Cat Gamers Director did that?
scripts.translation:
[等待的貓]
為什麼有人把花瓶放在玻璃杯裡？
是貓玩家總監乾的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Waiting Cat]
What strange taste.
Maybe I should rethink joining 'Cat Gamers', huh?
scripts.translation:
[等待的貓]
味道好奇怪。
也許我應該重新考慮加入“貓玩家”了，嗯？

scripts.text: ^0000FFThere's a hastily written message on this bulletin board.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF公告板上有一條匆忙寫下的留言。^000000

scripts.text: A fallen angel within will unlock a hidden enchantment to Archangel Wings.
scripts.translation: 內部有一位墮天使，將解鎖永恆之翼的隱藏附魔。

scripts.text: You are carrying too many items, please reduce them and come back!
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品太多了，請減少一些後再來！

scripts.text: You have overweight, please reduce it and come back!
scripts.translation: 你超重了，請減輕重量後再來！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
You seem like a poor guy!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
你看起來好窮啊！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
If you have an Archangel Wing, I will enchant my capability into the useless 4th slot. Would you like me to do so?
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
如果你有天使之翼，我可以將我的能力附魔到那個無用的第4個槽位上。你願意讓我這麼做嗎？

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text: Enchant Initialization
scripts.translation: 附魔初始化

scripts.text: Stop speaking
scripts.translation: 閉嘴

scripts.text: What are you going to do?
scripts.translation: 你要做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
你說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can enchant my capability into your Archangel Wing if you pay 1,000,000 zeny. But you can't enchant it again without resetting it.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
如果你支付1,000,000 Zeny，我可以將我的能力附魔到你的天使之翼上。但如果不重置，就無法再次附魔。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The enchantment is dangerous, so ^ff0000the wing might be damaged^000000! Nevertheless, my good blessing will retain the ^0000ffcard and refine level^0000ff!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
附魔很危險，所以^ff0000翅膀可能會損壞^000000！不過，我的祝福會保留^0000ff卡片和精煉等級^0000ff！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
如果你付不起錢，我就不能做！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
There are 2 important notices. First, the enchantment requires ^0000ff1,000,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
有兩點重要通知。首先，附魔需要^0000ff1,000,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Second, ^ff0000although the rate is not high, the Archangel Wing might be damaged^000000! This is very unlucky!
If you can accept these conditions, I will enchant the wing for you.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
其次，^ff0000雖然機率不高，但天使之翼可能會損壞^000000！這非常不幸！
如果你能接受這些條件，我就為你附魔。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下...

scripts.text: I accept, let's enchant!
scripts.translation: 我接受，開始附魔吧！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
好的！請慢慢考慮！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
天使之翼已經取出來了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Don't take off the item!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
不要取下物品！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This Archangel Wing is enchanted! Please initialize it or bring another Archangel Wing for me!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
這個天使之翼已經附魔了！請初始化它，或者帶另一個天使之翼來給我！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Be merciful to the survivor,
Send flowers to the dead.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
善待倖存者，
為逝者獻花。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Help for justice,
Elimination of evil.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
伸張正義，
剷除邪惡。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
But the important point is... the Archangel Wing is damaged!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
但重要的是...天使之翼損壞了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
I believe that you will become the dominator of the new world!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
拿著吧！
我相信你會成為新世界的統治者！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Initialization requires ^0000ff3 units of Silvervine Fruit^000000. The wing will not be damaged except for the enchanted capability.
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
初始化需要^0000ff3個獼猴桃果實^000000。除了附魔效果外，翅膀不會受到損壞。

scripts.text: Let me consider...
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下...

scripts.text: Ok, I want initialize it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我要初始化它。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Ok! Take your time to consider!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
好的！請慢慢考慮！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
The Archangel Wing has been taken out!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
天使之翼已經取出來了！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Oh... you have unequipped the Archangel Wing!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
哦...你已卸下天使之翼！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
I can't do it if you can't pay!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
如果你付不起錢，我就不能做！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
This equipment has not been enchanted, please check it again!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
這件裝備沒有附魔，請再次確認！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Angel]
Take it!
scripts.translation:
[墮天使]
拿著吧！
